tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ chos tshul sna tshogs las brtsams te 'bel gtam du bgyis pa'i rabs me tog chun 'phyang lags/ 322)swasti pra dzā bh+yaḥ gzod nas rab zhi mnyam nyid dag pa'i mkhar// ye shes rdzu 'phrul thugs rje'i 'od dkar gsal// gang 'dul gdul bya'i dad mtshor chu zla'i gar// ston mdzad bla ma'i zhabs pad la btud nas// mi pham chos kyi spyan ldan skyes mchog gis// zab rgyas chos kyi 'bel gtam spro mdzad pa'i// mchid lan chos kyi dgongs don ji lta ba// nus min chos kyi go tshod 'ba' zhig 'bul/ de la sngar dri lan bskal bzang dga' byed phul ba la nye bar spros nas slar yang bka'i phebs sgor/ sngags kyi lam la 'jug pa'i thog mar/ smin 323)byed bum pa'i dbang len par bya ba la yang snod bcud ye nas dkyil 'khor du shes pa dang*/ phung khams lhar shes pa'i bskyed rim dang*/ de las kyang sngon du swa bhā wa'i sngags don gyi stong nyid bsgom shes dgos na/ slob ma de nyid sngar nas bskyed rdzogs kyi don dang ldan pa zhig dgos par 'gyur ba dang*/ de ltar na smin grol gnyis kyi snga rting gi rim pa yang don med du 'gyur ba'i phyir/ tshul 'di ji ltar yin gyi dri ba gnang ba'i cha la/ lan du phul ba ni/ gang zhig sngags kyi lam la brten nas tshe gcig byang chub bsgrub par 'dod pa des ni thog mar bla ma mtshan ldan la smin byed 324)legs par zhus nas/ de rjes grol byed bskyed rdzogs la 'jug pa'i snga phyi go rim ma log pa ni nges par dgos lags kyi/ smin byed kyi dbang thog mar zhu ba po de bskyed rdzogs kyi don ji lta ba sngar nas mi shes mod kyang*/ de ltar shes pa'i rgyu'i snod rung du bsgrub phyir/ dang po slob ma sta gon gyi las rim rnams kyi rgyud sbyangs/ skyabs sems sdom bzung sogs kyis thun mong gi theg pa'i lam srol du bcug dkyil 'khor du gzhug cing lha ngo bstan te snod gzhal yas khang dang bcud lha tshogs kyi bzhugs tshul phyi nang gzhan gsum gyi dag sbyor dang bcas pas ngo sprad nas ye gdod ma'i yin lugs dang gnas tshul gyi nges shes bskyed/

de lta bu'i gnad don gyi skal ba dang ldan pa la gsang ba bsgrags na dngos grub kyi gegs su 'gyur phyir gsang ba'i dam tshig phogs/ 'gro khams bde gshegs snying po ro gcig kyang gnas skabs su/ rang rang gi sngon gyi las 'phro gang la yod pa'i lha'i rigs brtag phyir 325)me tog gi cod paṇa dor/ de nyid gang la babs pa'i lha de yi dam du 'bog cing rigs dang mthun pa'i gsang mtshan gdags pa dang bcas pa'i las rim rnams kyis/ dper na slob gnyer gyi thog mar yi ge slob pa lta bu'am/ rab byung bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i sngon du dge bsnyen dang*/ bar pa rab byung sogs su bsgrub te/ spang blang gis gnas la goms su 'jug pa'i mthus/ dngos gzhi la bde blag tu spyod nus par 'gyur ba'i dpe dang mtshungs phyir go rim 'gal ba sogs med la/ khyad par slob ma lhar skyed pa'i skabs su/ swa bhā wa'am/ shu n+ya ta'i sngags kyi sbyong ba yang slob mas ji lta bar sgom mi shes kyang slob dpon nyid kyis bya ba'i sgo nas ma dag mtshan 'dzin gyis rtog pa sbyang ste sgo gsum lha de nyid kyi ngo bor byin gyis brlab cing ye shes bcug pa ni/ dper na/ seng ge'i 'o ma ni gser dngul rin chen gyi snod ma gtogs/ rdza shing sogs phal pa'i snod du blug na 326)snod chag cing bcud bo ba lta bu'i nyes pa mi 'byung ba'i phyir du/ dbang bskur gyi slob ma dam tshig sems dpa' ru skyed cing ye shes sems dpa' bstim pa de dag mi phyed par dbang bskur zhing rgyas gdab pa yin pa dang*/ de'i tshe bla ma dang chos kyi byin rlabs dang ting nge 'dzin gyis nus pa/ slob ma'i mos gus/ rdzas sngags rten 'brel gyi rgyu rkyen sogs kyi mthus/ slob ma'i rgyud la bskyed rdzogs kyi don ci rigs skal ba dang mthun par shar ba de la dbang don gyi ye shes zer ba lags mod kyi/ de ni dper na zhing pa rnams thog mar rmo 'khrol chu lud sogs kyi sa bon gdab rung du bsgrubs nas skabs la nam babs tshe sa bon skyon med bskrun par byed pa lta bu ni/

smin byed kyi dgos don yin pa dang*/ slad du sa bon de dag mi rul mi skam gnod pa gzhan gyis chud 'dza' ba sogs su mi 'gyur ba'i thabs du mas legs par bskyangs pas/ rim gyis myu gu dang 327)ljang pa snye ma sogs su 'grub pa'i mthar 'bras bu smin par 'gyur ba ni grol byed lam gyi dpe lags pa dang*/ yang*/ 'o na gdod ma nas sangs rgyas kyis rgyu dang sgo gsum dkyil 'khor gsum du lhun gyis grub na/ slar smin grol du bya rgyu ci zhig snyam na/ dper na zhing sa dang sa bon yod kyang 'debs pa dang gso bskyed kyi rtsol ba ma byas na 'bras bu mi thob pa lta bu dang*/ dpe gzhan yang*/ mdo rgyud rnams nas rgya cher gsungs pa bzhin no/ gser dngul gyi rdo yang bzhu btul la rag las pa dang*/ til dang 'o ma la mar gyis khyab kyang btsir ba dang bsrub pa'i rtsol ba dgos tshul sogs dang mtshungs pa nyid do/ des na/ smin grol gnyis kyi go rim dang dgos don ni de ltar lags shing*/ bum dbang des mtshon nas dbang gzhan rnams kyang de dang de'i nyams len gyi gong du thob dgos tshul ni skal bzang dga' byed du yod pa ltar lags pa dang*/ rgyud sde 'og ma dag la ni lha gang yin pa de nyid bsgom zhing 328)bsgrub pa la dbang phyir rigs gtad rjes gnang sogs kyi chog mod kyang*/ bla med kyi lam yongs rdzogs zhig la nyams len byed na de nyid kyi dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs thob dgos tshul dang*/ dbang snga mas ma smin par phyi ma bskur du mi rung ba sogs kyang bskal bzang dga' byed du bshad pa bzhin rim nod go ma log par bya la/ yang*/ gang zag gis khyad kyi/ kun rdzob cho ga'i dbang bskur kho na la ltos dgos sogs kyang ma nges mod kyi/ gang ltar yang*/ grol lam nyams su len rgyu ni smin lam dbang don gyi ye shes nyid yin phyir/ smin grol gyi go rim snga phyi ni 'di kas rtogs par 'gyur ba'o/

skabs 'dir 'phros don/ swa bhā wa'i sngags don 'di la/ phyis byon gyis mkhas pa rnams kyi bzhed par/ swa bhā was 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad rang bzhin gdod nas dag pa'i stong nyid kyi don dang*/ shu n+ya ta ni chos thams cad kyi yul gdod nas dag pa'i stong nyid de dang yul can ye shes gnyis 329)dbyer med pa'i stong nyid kyi don yin no zhes pa'i dbye ba mdzad mod kyang*/ bdag gi blun tshod la ni/ 'di gnyis la dbye ba byed don zhig yod pa ma mthong ste/ sngags 'di gnyis kyi 'bru don la brtag na/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha zhes pa ni rang bzhin gyis dag pa dang*/ sarba dharma ni chos thams cad/ swa bh+wa wa shud+dhony+raṃ ni rang bzhin gyis dag pa'i bdag nyid do/ zhes par 'gyur pa dang*/ oṃ ma hā shu n+ya ta ni stong pa nyid chen po/ dz+nya na badz+ra ni ye shes rdo rje/ swa bhā wa ni rang bzhin/ at+ma kony+ra haṃ ni bdag nyid do zhes pa'am/ nga nyid do zhes par 'gyur spyir/ gdod nas dag pa'i stong nyid ye shes 'gyur ba med pa'i rdo rje'i ngo bo'i bdag nyid kyi don gsal 'debs pa nyid yin par go lags/ yang*/ la la'i bzhed kyis/ las dang po pa'i gang zag rnams kyis dngos po'i chos rnams gzhigs nas stong nyid bsgom pa dang*/ goms pa rnams rang bzhin gyis gdod nas dag pa'i stong nyid dran 330)pa gnyis gang zag gi khyad yin gsung mkhan snang yang*/ snga ma de ni/ phyi nang gi chos thams cad mi dmigs par stong pa nyid du 'gyur/ ces pa'i tshig la bsam 'dug na'ang*/ mi dmigs par gyur bsam pa de ka dmigs pa ches che shos su 'gyur la/ blos byas kyi stong nyid de ni gdod ma'i gnas lugs su nam yang mi 'gyur ba'i phyir dang*/ sngags de nyid kyi skad dod la rang bzhin gyis dag pa zhes pa de dang rgyab 'gal du 'gro bas na/ sngags don du nam yang mi 'gyur bar go'o/ 'o na/ las dang po ba rnams kyi sngags don 'di sgom thabs gtan nas med par thal lo snyam na/

de yang ma yin te/ gdod ma'i ye shes ma rtogs pa'i gang zag las dang po ba rnams swa bhā ba'am shu n+ya ta brjod tshe/ snod bcud kyi snang ba sogs 'di thams cad rang nyid kyi bden 'dzin a 'thas su bzung ba'i bag chags 'khrul ngor 'di lta bu snang bar zad kyis/ don dam par bden rdzun rtag chad yod med sogs sgro skur gyis mtshan ma mtha' 331)dag gis dben pa'i tshul rgyal ba rnams kyi mdo rgyud mtha' dag tu gsungs pa bzhin tu yin par gdon mi za'o snyam pa'i nges shes bskyed par gsungs pas/ mos pas stong nyid du byed pa 'dis kyang dngos 'dzin zhi thub par sgam po pas kyang gsungs la/ dang por 'di tsam gyi tshul la nges shes 'grongs na/ slad mar rim gyi rang bzhin gdod nas dag pa'i stong nyid rtogs pa la dka' tshegs med par 'gyur ba ste/ mi dmigs pa'i stong par gyur snyam pa'i mtshan 'dzin/ de dang mi gcig go de ltar brjod bya'i tshig gcig kyang brjod byed kyi don la go ba len tshul tha dad pa 'di 'dra mang pos gang zag rnams lam log lam gol lam nor du gyur pa mang ngo*/ mdor na/ bskyed rim mam/ gtor mchod byin rlabs sogs swa bhā wa brjod pa'i skabs nam du'ang*/ da lta mngon sum du bshams pa'am yod pa'i dngos po 'di rnams ci yang med par 332)song ngo bsam par byed pa la swa bhā ba'i sngags don du 'khrul bar mi bya ste/ 'bag btsog gam mtshan 'dzin gyi rtog pa de kho rang stong nyid du sbyang thabs yin pa'i gnad go bar bya ba 'di yang rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi gal che shos gcig tu gda' lags/ de ltar sngags don 'di'i dgos ched ni/ jo bo rje'i gsungs las kyang*/ de lta bu'i sngags rnam pa gnyis lan gsum du brjod pa ni/ stong pa nyid rtogs nus pa dang*/ stong nyid kyi dran pa gso ba dang*/ gnas pa brtan pa dang*/ ye shes kyi tshogs rdzogs pa dang*/ tha mal pa'i lus ngag yid gsum gyi zhen rtog spong ba dang*/

rten dang rten pa thams cad stong pa nyid kyi rnam 'phrul du rtogs pa'i phyir ro/ zhes gsungs shing*/ don gyi snying po ni/ 'khor 'das kyi bsdus pa'i chos mtha' dag dang por yang stong nyid kyi ngang nas 'gags med kyi rtsal mdangs su shar/ da lta yang ji ltar shar ba'i ngo bo stong nyid las ma g.yos par gnas/ mthar yang stong nyid kyi klong 333)du thim/ de lta bu shar gnas/ thim gsum yang med bzhin snang ba stong pa nyid kyi rnam rol du thag chod pa ni chos thams cad kyi yin tshul ji lta bar rtogs pa'o/ yang nyid kyis/ he ru ka'i dbang la rdor sems kyi brtul zhugs bstan pa dang*/ brtul zhugs nyid kyi don yang ma go gsungs pa yang*/ spyir bum dbang gi mtha' rten gyi rnam grangs 'dren tshul rgyas bsdus dang snga phyi mi 'dra ba sna tshogs pa gsar rnying so so'i gzhung las 'byung mod kyi/ slob dpon a bha ya sogs kyis ni/ sangs rgyas kyi thugs ye shes rdo rje dang mi 'bral bar rtogs phyir rdo rje'i dam tshig chos thams cad rang bzhin med par rtogs phyir dril bu'i dam tshig lha sku phyag rgya chen po las mi 'da' ba phyag rgya'i dam tshig khams gsum chos kyi rgyal srid la dbang phyir slob dpon gyi dbang dngos dang*/ rdor sems kyi go 'phang la sgrib byed kyi dri ma 'khru phyir chu dbang*/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi bya ba bsgrub phyir de kho na nyid las rim dang bcas 334)pa'i dbang*/ sngags dang las bzhi'i dngos grub 'grub phyir sngags dbang*/ ma rig pa'i ling tog bsal zhing ye shes spyan gyi nus pa 'jog phyir mig sman sbyin pa/ chos thams cad rang bzhin med par rtogs byed me long bstan pa/ bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rgyal byed mda' gzhu'i dbang dang*/ rang dang gzhan gyi don gnyis mthar phyin pa'i nus pa thob phyir rjes gnang sbyin pa/ ye shes chen po'i don gyi bogs 'byin phyir brtul bzhugs sbyin pa/

ma 'ongs par mngon sangs rgyas nas srid pa gsum du 'gran zla dang bral ba'i ston par lung bstan zhing dbugs dbyung gzengs bstod dang bcas pa gsungs pa'i dbang 'di rnams la nang mtshan gyi dbye tshul 'dra min du mar yod pa dang*/ rnying lugs la ni 'di dag gi skabs su/ nang nus pa'i dbang*/ gsang ba rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang*/ yang gsang bka' rab 'byams kyi dbang sogs kyi rnam grangs 'byung mod la/ khyad par gyi skabs don du/ brtul bzhugs kyi dbang gi don ni/ lha dang rgyud sde gang 335)yin pa de nyid kyi cha byad dang lam dang spyod pa dang 'bras bu bsgrub pa la dbang bar byed thabs la brtul zhugs kyi ming du btags pa ste/ dper na/ 'dul ba nas kyang mkhan pos slob bu de la chos gos gsum dang lhung bzed dang chu tshags la sogs tshig gis gtad pa de dge slong gi brtul zhugs sbyin par 'gyur ba lta bu'i don yin no/ he ru ka'i dbang la rdor sems kyi brtul zhugs byung ba ni/ spyir rdo rje sems dpa' zhes pa'i mtshan 'jug pa ni mang na'ang*/ 'di skabs ni/ rdo rje sems dpa' rigs rnams kun gyi bdag ces gsungs pa ltar/ rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje 'dzin rdo rje sems dpa' sogs mtshan gyi rnam grangs dang*/ rnying lugs su chos sku kun bzang sogs su grags pa ltar/ rigs thams cad kyi khyab bdag la 'jug cing*/ de nyid khro bo'i tshul du bstan pa la he ru ka sogs kyi mtshan dang rnam 'gyur du ma ste/ ji skad du/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rdo rje// he ru ka dang dus 'khor lo// dang po'i sangs rgyas la sogs mtshan/ zhes 336)sogs dang*/ yo ga las kyang*// rdo rje sems dpa' sems dpa' che// rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ rdo rje dang po'i kun tu bzang*/ zhes pa dang dgongs pa mtshungs la/ 'di la sems dpa' zhes byang chub sems dpa' tsam la brjod pa yang ma yin te/ dam tshig sems dpa'/

ye shes sems dpa'/ ting 'dzin sems dpa' sogs sems dpa'i mtshan gyi 'jug sgo mang mod kyi/ skabs don 'dir ni rdor sems dang he ru ka sogs ming tha dad kyang ngo bo dbyer med rigs bdag bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid la 'du zhing de'i brtul zhugs kyi go 'phang bsgrub pa'i dbang gi bye brag lags/ ༈ yang*/ dus 'khor gyi dbang gi skabs kyi/ rlung bcu dang nus ma bcu gang yin gsungs pa/ rlung ni rtsa ba'i rlung me mnyam sogs lnga dang*/ rgyu ba dang rab tu rgyu sogs yan lag gi rlung lnga ste bsdoms pa'i bcu po de ka lags shing nus ma bcu'i ngo bo ni/ sha khrag drod dbugs sems dang bcas pa'i nang gi khams lnga dang*/ bdud rtsi lnga ste/ de ltar bcu po ye shes kyi lha mo'i ngo bor 337)shar ba la 'jug par gda' ste/ dus 'khor nyid kyi lugs ltar 'di dag bcu po'i { spyi tsam du ni nus ma bcu de sbyor drug gi mun khrid kyi 'char tshul dang sgo bstun te/ nag mo 'bar ba/ ser mo 'bar ba/ dkar mo 'bar ba/ dmar mo 'bar ba/ du ba ma/ mig rgyu ma/ mar me ma/ mkha' snang ma/ 'di dag gi steng du/ sna tshogs yum dang*/ dbyings phyug ma ste/ de ltar bcu po ni nus ma bcur gsungs so/

}nang tshan dang mngon rtogs sogs kyi gsal kha ni 'dir dus 'khor gyi yig cha'i rigs tsam ma bzhugs shing bdag la 'dris goms med pas khur ma mtshal la/ rgyud sde gzhan ma ltar na khams lnga po gnas su dag pa ni/ spyan ma sogs yum lnga dang*/ bdud rtsi lnga { skabs la lar rigs lnga la sbyor/ }ni gzugs rdo rje ma sogs yul lnga'i 'dod yon lnga'i lha mo la sbyor ba mang 'dug rung*/ dus 'khor rang lugs kyi skabs don gang yin pa ni de nyid rgyud 'grel dang dkyil chog sogs la dogs gcod gnang 'tshal lags/ ༈ sbyang gzhi 338)sbyong byed sogs kyi skabs su/ 'dod chags bzhi spang byar bshad pa ji ltar yin gsungs pa ni/ spyir gsang sngags kyi rgyud sde bzhi po byung tshul 'chad pa'i gzhung rnams su/ rdzogs ldan/ gsum ldan/ gnyis ldan/ rtsod ldan dang bzhi la 'dod chags bzhi rim can du yod pa'i gnyen por sngags kyi rgyud sde bzhi gsungs tshul dang*/ gzhan 'phrul sogs 'dod lha rnams dang 'dod chags bzhi po sbyar tshul sogs ni skabs 'dir brjod dgos par ma gyur la/ 'di'i skabs don ni/ 'dod chags sogs nyon mongs pa rnams nyan thos su spong*/ byang sems su bsgyur/ gsang sngags lam du 'khyer bar gsungs pa la/ 'dir spang byar bshad pa ci yin snyam na/ nyon mongs pa tha mal rang gar spyad rung ba ni theg pa gong 'og gang nas kyang ma bshad pa'i phyir na 'dir spyi tsam du spang byar bgrang la/ khyad don la lam du 'khyer tshul yang*/ man ngag gi gnad dang ldan na lam gyis grogs sam bogs 'don 339)du 'gyur la/ gnad kyis ma zin na dug sngags med par btsan dug za ba'am/ dngul chu 'chings ba'i man ngag med par longs spyod pa bzhin phung bar 'gyur ba'i gtan tshigs kyi dbang gis spang byar brjod pa lags kyis/ dbang bzhi'i skabs 'dir ni/ ji skad du/ dbang don rab dbye las/ bum dbang bltas pas tshim pa'i 'dod chags dag

/gsang dbang rgod pas tshim pa'i 'dod chags dag /shes rab ye shes gnyis 'khyud 'dod chags dag /tshig dbang lag bcangs tshim pa dag par byed// de ni 'dod chags bzhi po sbyong tshul lo/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dbang bzhi po des 'dod chags bzhi po'i tha mal rang ga'i dri ma sbyong nas dga' bzhi sogs kyi yon tan mngon du byed pa'i don lags mod/ dbang gsum pa'i don gyi lhan skyes ye shes bde stong zag med mngon du gyur pa'i yon tan grub thob rnams kyi ltar gyur pa zhig ma byung na thabs lam tshul ldan du mi 'gro tshul bdag 340)gis bskal bzang dga' byed du bshad pa la brten nas slar/ 'o na rtsa them rlung them gyi dgos pa gang yin pa 'dri bar mdzad pa la/ spyir yang*/ gsum pa'i lam gcig pu la ltos ma dgos par tshe gcig byang chub bsgrub thabs ni bsam gyis mi khyab mod kyi/ 'on kyang 'dod khams kyi sems can rnams kyi rgyu rkyen yang 'di la rag pa dang*/ de'i stobs kyi nyon mongs pa'i nang nas 'di nyid shas che ba dang*/ 'di lam du lhongs na grol zhing ma lhongs na 'ching nas 'khor bar 'khyams 'gyur gyi rgyu yin pa la dgongs te/ theg pa'i 'og mar spang bya'i gtso bo dang*/ gong mar lam du slong bya'i rtsa bar gsungs shing*/ dbang gi skabs su yang*/ dang po bdag gzhan snod bcud phung khams tha mal gyi zhen pa las bzlog phyir bum dbang bstan/ de nas rtsa dang rlung dang thig le rnams tha mal rang rgyud par zhen pa'i dri ma sbyong phyir gsang dbang bstan nas khyad par du sems kyi rtogs tshogs dang bde 341)sdug gi tshor ba sogs la chags sdang gis bag chags a 'thas 'khrul zhen las bzlog phyir sher dbang bskur bas/ nyon mongs pa rang 'chor ba'i nyes pa'i rtsa ba drung nas phyungs pa ste/ 'di skabs rnying lugs kyi dbang chog dag tu/ gsang ba'i dgra gsum gsad/ yul gsum mngon du gyur/ lam gsum gnad du tshud/

ces sogs kyi rnam dbye mang du gda' zhing*/ dgos don gyi gtso bor tha mal rang rgyud pa'i chags pa dag ste lhan skyes ye shes ngos zin pa ni dbang gsum pa'i don gyi rtsa bar snang zhing*/ de'i phyir/ rje btsun ras chung pa'i lo rgyus 'ga' zhig na/ dbang thob kyang ye shes ngos ma zin pa'i slob ma gcig zhes sogs kyi sgros 'dug pa ltar/ dbang yang thob la ye shes ngos yang zin pa zhig dgos par bzhed cing*/ de lta bu'i ye shes shar ba nyid slar yang nan chags su tshig gi ngo sprad brda yis nges shes bskyed/ gnad kyi gsang bstan/ don gyi 'gag 342)dkrol te/ 'khor 'das lam gsum gyi chos thams cad rang sems gcig pu'i thog tu gtan la 'bebs pa ni dbang bzhi pa yin tshe/ nyid kyis/ tshig dbang rin po che zhes pa'i nges tshig gang yin gsungs pa'i don yang*/ dbang bzhi pa 'di la kun rdzob rdzas kyi dbang la ma ltos par tshig gis ngo sprod pa la brten nas don la rang dbang thob par byed phyir dang*/ dbang gzhan rnams nor bu mching bu dang 'dra la/ 'di ni rin po che dbang gi rgyal po lta bu ste/ gzhan las khyad par mchog dang rag dang phul du gyur phyir/ tshig dbang rin po che zhes bya ba lags/ de ltar gong gi 'phro bzhin/ dbang gsum pa de bskur zhing nyams su blangs pa'i rten ni kun rjob rgyu'i thig le la rab las la/ de nyid la brten nas don dam ye shes kyi theg le mngon du gyur dgos pa dang*/ rgyu'i thig le zag med du 'ching zhing 'phel bar byed pa la rtsa them rlung them gyi man ngag la ma brten par de lta bu 343)ma nus shing*/ de mi nus bzhin du gsum pa'i lam la 'bad par rloms kyang rtsa ltung lnga pa sogs nyes pa mang po'i rgyur 'gyur ba las/ yon tan gyi bskal bas dben pa'i tshul ni/ gsang ba bla na med pa'i 'bras bu dri ma med pa snying po'i rgyud las/ thig le mtha' bral bde stong che// 'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das pa// thams cad kun gyi srog yin te// phyi ltar ma rtogs 'byung ba lnga// nang ltar rtogs na sku lnga dang*// gsang ba ye shes chos nyid dngos// thams cad sangs rgyas rang bzhin gyis// rtsa khams dpa' bo mkha' 'gro yin// rgyu yi thig le dwangs ma ni// til 'bru tsam zhig nyams gyur na// bde stong ye shes yon tan dang*// myang 'das srog rtsa bcad pa'i phyir// mkha' 'gro khri 'bum ngu dir 'gyur// dngos grub dam pa nyams pa yin// de nyid ma nyams longs spyad na// bde stong ye shes yon tan 'phel// rang rig bde ba chen po'i ngang*// mkha' 'gro ma lus mnyes gyur te// 'khor 'das thams cad dbang du 'du/

344)zhes sogs dang*/ de ltar ma shes thig le spangs/ yi dam phyi nas bsgom pa dang*// tshogs dang mchod pa phyir 'bul zhing*// dngos grub gzhan nas thob 'dod rnams// grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags kyang*// ye shes rang la rang gsal du// yod bzhin gnad don ma rig pas// 'khor ba'i bag chags grol mi 'gyur/ zhes sogs rgya cher gsungs pa'i phyir/ thabs kun+da 'dzag med du spel zhing*/ shes rab lhan skyes ye shes las mi 'da' bar bsgrub phyir/ rtsa rlung them bu'i dgos pa ni der 'du mod kyi/ ye shes kyi ma zin par thig le 'ching nus pa gcig pus ni gnas skabs lus kyi mdangs stobs mi nyams pa tsam e yod dam/ mthar thug gi myur lam du 'gro ba ni mi srid pa'i phyir/ skal bzang dga' byed du skyon gyi rnam grangs bshad pa'i don de ltar lags/ ༈ yang*/ dbang bzhi thob tshul sa lam dang sbyar ba'i skabs su/ dus 'khor dang dgongs pa mthun par nang don 345)'grel pa sogs su sa bcu gnyis pa'i bar du/ bde mchog tu rtsa nyer bzhi'i dag pa dang sbyar zhing sa bcu pa man las ma gsungs pas/ bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa sogs kyi sgros ma byung gsungs pa/ ༈ de la spyir/ sa lam gyi rnam gzhag thams cad ni chos rang rang so so'i nyams len gyi 'bras bu 'grub tshul gyi bye brag yin phyir/ rgyu'i theg pa rnams su ni pha rol tu phyin pa bcu la brten nas sa lam bgrod tshul dang*/ sngags kyi theg pa ni rim pa gnyis kyi lam la brten nas bgrod dgos phyir lam gang la brten pa de dang mtshungs pa'i rtags dang yon tan gyi ldog chos dang sbyar bas na mtha' gcig tu ni ma nges mod kyi/ dbang bzhi dang sbyar ba de ni sa'i rim pa de dag thob rung gi nus pa'am sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa yin pas na/ de rnams kyi lam ji ltar nyams su blangs pa'i nus pa mngon du gyur tshul dang 'brel dgos par ni gzhir bcas te

346)mtshan bcas rtsa rlung thig le'i nyams len gyi gzhung rnams las ni de dag gi dag 'bras dang sbyar nas gsungs la/ mtshan med kyi rdzogs rim phyag rgya chen po la sogs su ni rnal 'byor bzhi rim sogs dang sbyar nas gsungs mod kyi/ mthar thug gi skyel so ni nam yang sangs rgyas kyi sar khyad par ma mchis la/ gnas skabs lam myur khyad kyi bye brag ni mdo rgyud bstan bcos rnams las 'byung ba bzhin sna tshogs dang*/ spyi khyab tu ni sa bcu mthar phyin tshe shes sgrib bag la nyal gyi cha phra mo ma gtogs gzhan ni mthong spangs bsgom spangs kyi dri ma mtha' dag zad pas dag bya'am sbyang bya'i dri ma dang bral ba'i gnas skabs der/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi 'od zer chen pos dbang bskur bas shes sgrib kyi lhag ma phra zhing phra ba yang zad nas 347)'tshang rgya ba dang*/ de skabs yon tan gyi ldog cha la ming gi tha snyad tsam du sa bcu gcig bcu gnyis bcu gsum pa rnams su bgrangs pa tsam las/ 'og ma'i sa rnams kyi bgrod tshul ltar mi dgos pa la dgongs nas/ bcu pa yan ma bstan pa dang*/ bcu gsum pa'i ming ma gsungs pa sogs de ltar yin par go la/ yang*/ 'ga' zhig tu ni yon tan gyi ldog cha la dbye ba'i rnam grangs sa bco lnga dang*/ bcu drug dang nyer gcig sogs kyi bar du bgrang ba yang snang mod kyi/ don dam par ni sku gsum 'du 'bral med pa'i ye shes gzhi lam 'bras gsum nam du yang 'pho 'gyur bri gang med par bzhugs pa nyid la 'du ba ste/ ji skad du/ rtogs pa'i ye shes skad cig la// phyir mi ldog pa bden pa'i don// mngon sum mthong phyir sa rnams ni// kun rjob tsam du bstan pa las// yang dag don du rang las ni// sa zhes bya ba gud na med// bgrod du med 348)de rang rig la// mun pa'i dkyil du nyi shar bzhin// thams cad ma lus dus gcig rdzogs/ ces dang*/ lam pa rnams dang sgo bstun na// sdug bsngal bde bar shar ba yis// sa ni dang po rab tu dga'// the tshom dri ma bral ba yis// gnyis pa dri ma med pa'i sa// rang snang ye shes gsal 'grib med// gsum pa 'od byed sa yin no// 'od gsal snang ba phyogs bcur khyab// bzhi pa 'od 'phro'i sa zhes bya// nyon mongs snang ba rang dag pas// lnga pa sbyangs dka'i sa ru 'dod// rang rig thig le'i skur smin pas// drug pa mngon du gyur pa'i sa// de la goms pas 'khor ba dag

/bdun pa ring du song ba'i sa// sku yi 'od dang zhing khams rgyas// brgyad pa mi g.yo'i sa non pa'o// de nyid mi 'gyur bstan pa yis// dgu pa legs pa'i blo gros yin// chos nyid rang gsal lhug par shar// bcu pa chos kyi sprin zhes bya// de ltar bden mthong gang zag ste// lus 349)'di ma bor sa bcu non// gzung 'dzin lus brgya grol ba'i tshe// snang srid chos sku'i dkyil 'khor nyid// ye shes sku yis 'od kyis khyab// bcu gcig kun 'od sa zhes bya// de la zhen chags rtog sgrib med// bcu gnyis ma chags pad+ma'i sa// sku dang zhing khams 'khor gyi tshogs// gsal la 'dzin med ye shes klong*// bcu gsum 'khor lo tshogs chen pa// bde chen ye shes 'gyur med sku// bcu bzhi bde ba chen po'i sa// lhun grub ye shes rtsal chen rdzogs// bco lnga rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa// rnam par mi rtog ye shes ldan// sa rnams ma lus sa gcig ste// lhag bcas tshul du mngon sangs rgya/ zhes pa la sogs rgya cher gsungs pas na/ sa lam gyi bgrod tshul nges nges rtag rtag gzhung gcig kho na nas bshad pa bzhin kun mtshungs par mi 'byung ba ni/ chos dbyings bsam mi khyab pa'i gnas lugs yin par gda' bas/ de ltar 350)dgongs 'tshal zhing*/ rtsa rlung thig le'i dag 'bras kyi sa lam { dbu ma'i rtsa mdud gnyis gnyis grol ba'i sa bcu re re thob tshul sogs/ }bgrod tshul 'ba' zhig pa'i zhib cha ni/ nang don gyi rang 'grel dang*/ ngo khro 'grel chen sogs su gzigs pa las lhag pa zhig rmongs pa bdag 'dras 'bul rgyu ga la mchis/ yang*/ bum dbang gis bskyed rim bstan nas/ dbang bzhi pas rdzogs rim shugs la bstan pa yin nam/ gsungs pa la/ gsang sngags 'og ma rnams las ni bskyed rim gtso cher gsungs shing*/ de mthar rdzogs rim la bsdu tshul phyogs mtshon tsam dang*/ gnas skabs kyi las tshogs bstan pa ma gtogs/

rim gnyis kyi lam yongs rdzogs ma gsungs tshe/ dbang yang de dang 'tshams par rjes gnang rig gtad las mi 'byung mod la/ bla med kyi rgyud sde so so'i smin grol gyi gzhung las ni/ thog mar bum dbang gi lus sku rdo rje ye nas gnas kyang 351)rang gi rang ma rig par bsgribs pa'i dri ma bsal te/ bskyed rim gyi lam bstan/ de bzhin du/ gsang dbang gis ngag gsung rdo rje dang*/ bzlas brjod sngags kyi lam bstan zhing rdzogs rim mtshan bcas rtsa thig rlung gsum byin gyis brlabs/ sher dbang gis yid thugs rdo rje dang*/ bde stong gsal stong rig stong sogs rang la rang chas su gnas tshul ngo sprad/ de nas dbang bzhi pas dbyer med ye shes rdo rje 'khor 'das lam gsum sems la ngo sprod gsal 'debs kyi sgo nas mtshan med kyi rdzogs rim gcer mthong mdzub tshugs su bstan pa ste/ mdor na bum dbang gi bskyed rim dang*/ gzhan gsum pos rdzogs rim ston pa yin pas na/ bzhi po de la ni lam gyis rim pa chags lam grol lam thams cad tshang bas/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi bar la thug pa'i nyams len mtha' dag ston pa ni bla med kyi khyad chos su gda' lags shing*/ gzhan yang*/ rnying lugs 352)ltar gyis dbang bzhis sdom gsum thob lugs sa dang sbyar tshul 'di ltar yang mchis te/ rgyud rnams kun gyi don 'dus pa// rdo rje'i gnas gsum smin byed dbang*// lus ni rgyal ba'i sku rdo rjer// ma shes ye shes bskyed pa'i lam// snang stong lha yi skur byed pa// bum pa'i dbang ni dang po ste// sngags kyi dge bsnyen nyid du 'gyur// bcu gnyis sa yi 'bras bu thob// ngag ni rgyal ba'i gsung rdo rje// smin byed grags stong sngags kyi bcud// rnam rtog nad sel bdud rtsi'i sman// gnyis pa gsang ba'i dbang bskur bas// dge tshul nyid 'gyur bcu gsum pa// 'khor lo tshogs chen yon tan thob// sems ni rgyal ba'i thugs rdo rje// gzung 'dzin bag chags rnam dag pa'i// bde stong ye shes chos nyid mkhar// lhan cig skyes pa'i don rtogs phyir// gsum pa shes rab ye shes bskur// 'dod chags dag pa dge slong mchog

/bcu bzhi bde ba chen po thob// sgo gsum ye shes sku gsung thugs// gnyis 353)med mnyam sbyor ngo sprod mchog /dbang gi nang nas dbang chog ste// bzhi pa tshig dbang rin chen bskur// sgo gsum rnam dag ye shes kyi// phyag rgya chen por rab sbyor bas// bco lnga rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa// mnyam sbyor sdom pa'i mchog ldan pa'o/ zhes gsungs pa dang*/ de bzhin du lam lnga bgrod pa'i tshul yang*/ rdo rje theg pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir// bla ma mnyes pas tshogs lam bgrod// byin rlabs zhugs pas sbyor lam ste// dag snang 'byongs pas mthong lam 'char// dbang bskur thob pas sgom pa'i lam// bskyed rdzogs mthar phyin tshe gcig gis// rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'bras bu thob/ ces gsungs la/ gzhan yang dbang bzhi'i skabs 'di la/ rgyal ba yang dgon pas 'di ltar gsungs te/ rgyu'i dus su dbang bzhi thob pa ste ji ltar yin tshul gyi don ngo shes/ lam gyi dus su goms par byed pa ste/ dbang bzhi so so'i mngon par rtogs pa nyams su blangs pas/ 'bras bu'i dus su dbang bzhi 354)'char ba ste/ sa bcu rgyun mtha'i byang chub sems dpa' de grags chen du 'tshang rgya khar 'od zer chen po'i dbang gis sbas pa nang gi sa gsum bgrod nas rgyu'i dus na dbang bzhis rtsa rlung thig sems bzhi la sku bzhi'i rten 'brel bsgrigs pa'i don ji lta ba 'bras bu'i dus su mngon du gyur pas rdo rje 'dzin pa'i go 'phang thob pa'o/ zhes gsungs pa 'dir 'gag 'dus par go lags/ ༈ de nas yang*/ grol byed lam gyi skabs su bskyed rdzogs gnyis po'i dri ba gnang ba'i cha la/ 'di gnyis so so rim gyis bsgom pa'i lugs dang zung 'jug gcig car du bsgom pa'i lugs gnyis bshad pa ni gnas skabs su gang zag rim gyis sa dang gcig char ba'i khyad dang*/ goms pa thob ma thob dang*/ rgyud sde'i gong 'og gi khyad par sogs las byung mod cing*/

mthar thug don gyis ngo bo la ni de gnyis dbyer med zung 'jug las mi 'da' ba'i rgyu mtshan ni 'og nas ston la/ dang por rim can du bsgom tshul 355)gyi skabs 'dir/ nyid kyi/ bde mchog dril bu lugs kyi bskyed rim bsgom pa'i rjes thob tu sems dpa'i thugs ka'i thig le ting 'dzin la shes pa gtad de 'jog pa'i rdzogs rim dang*/ de dag slar phyi nas rim can du bsdus mthar dmigs med du mnyam par 'jog pa'i mtshan ma'i rnal 'byor gsungs pa de dang*/ lha lnga par rdzogs rim dngos phyi ma 'di ltar gsungs pa de gnyis mthun ma byung zhes gsungs pa la/ gong ma de ni spyir mtshan bcas kyi rdzogs rim du 'dug pas na/ de'i dgongs pa ni 'di skabs bskyed rim dngos gzhi dril bu pa'i rim lnga sogs las ston par bzhed pa yin par sems la/ lha lnga'i gzhung ltar gsungs tshul de ni bskyed rdzogs rim can du bsgom tshul spyi 'gro dang bstun nas gsungs par gda' mod kyi/ lar/ snying ga'i thig le sogs la brten pa la mi zab pa'i rdzogs rim mam/ sems 'dzin gyi rdzogs rim zhes grags 356)la/ zab pa'i rdzogs rim ni spros bral stong chen nyid la bzhed pa dang*/ yang*/ nyal ba'i rnal 'byor gyi skabs rnams su yang*/ snying kha'i 'od dang thig le la gtad pa'i rigs rnams ni nyams kyi 'od gsal 'dzin thabs yin la/ spros med mnyam bzhag gi ngang la gnyid du byed pa ni rtog pa'i 'od gsal 'dzin thabs yin pa'i tshul ni gsar rnying phal cher mthun no/ des na bde mchog dril bu lugs kyi bya ba la 'jug skabs bsdu rim ma bshad pa de ni nyal ba'i rnal 'byor ma gtogs thun mtshams gzhan mi byed par bskyed rim rgyun mi chad du bsgom pa'i dbang du mdzad pa los yin/ gzhan bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug la ni bsdu rim mi dgos mod kyi/ zung 'brel lam rim can du bsgom pa'i skabs 'dir ni mthun mtshams kyi bya ba la 'jug skabs bskyed rim bsdus pa nges par mdzad pa phyag bzhed dang*/

'on kyang*/ bskyed rim gyi mnyam gzhag de nyid bsdus nas rdzogs rim 357)gyis mthar bsngo smon gyi rgyas gdab pa sogs grub/ rjes slar yang chu las nya 'phar ba lta bu'i krong bskyed kyi ngang nas bya ba gang yin la 'jug pa ni bskyed rim gyi rjes thob yin pa dang*/ de lta bu'i lha'i 'du shes dang ma bral na bza' btung tshogs 'khor ci smras bzlas brjod/ ci byed 'gro don sogs rdo rje theg pa'i lam khyer gyi gnad thams cad rtsol med lhun grub tu 'byung ba nyid dang*/ de lta bu rjes thob kyi lha'i nga rgyal dang mi ldan par tha mal pa'i 'du shes kyis ni sngags kyi rtsa ltung phog pa'i rgyu rkyen 'ba' shig las mi 'byung ba ste/ ji skad du/ dran dang shes bzhin mi ldan na// theg chen sngags su ci yis tshud/ ces gsungs phyir/ gsang sngags kyi dam tshig spyi dang*/ khyad par dbang bzhi'i dam tshig skal bzang dga' byed du bshad pa de rnams kyang mi thub tshe/ bskyed rdzogs bsgom pa don ldan du nam yang mi 'gyur la/ de'i phyir bdag gis bskal 358)bzang dga' byed du da lta'i chos pa rnams la skur pa 'debs shor ba'i rgyu mtshan yang de ltar yin pa dang*/ rje sa paṇa gyis/ des na 'dul ba'i bstan pa ni// gzugs brnyan tsam zhig ding sang snang*// 'bras bu gsang sngags bstan pa ni// gzugs brnyan tsam yang mi snang ngo*/ zhes gsus pa de ltar zad do/ 'dul ba ni dngos po'i bya ba gtso che zhing*/ gsang sngags ni dmigs pa'i bsam pa gtso che tshe/ ding sang bsam pa 'jig rten tha mal pa ltar byas nas spyod pa gsang sngags kyi lugs yin zer ba 'di 'dra ni dam pa'i chos kyi phyogs gang du yang mi nye bar mngon sum tshad grub tu gyur to/ de bas na bskyed rim bsgom mkhan yin tshad/ rgyud sde gong 'og gi lha gang dang gang yin rung*/ rnam pa gsal ba/ rnam dag dran pa/ nga rgyal brtan pa rnams kyi sgo nas snang ba sku'i 'khyer so/

sgra grags gsung gi 'khyer so/ dran rtog thugs kyi 'khyer 359)so rnams med thabs mi 'byung phyir/ rab kyi rtogs pa/ 'bring gi go ba/ tha ma gsar bu ba dag kyang mos pa lam byed kyi blo tsam zhig med na bskyed rim du nam yang mi 'gyur ba lags pas/ bla ma'am slob dpon rnams kyis kyang slob ma rnams kyi blo tshod la dpags pa'i go rtogs sprod mkhas pa zhig gal che bar gda' lags/ ༈ rdor sems phyag rdor sgrol ma sogs la rgyud sde'i rnam dbye shes dka' bar 'dug gsungs pa rgyud sde'i rim pa ni gdul bya'i blo rigs tha dad la dgongs pa yin phyir/ rang rang gang la mos pa der zhugs nas de nyid kyi lugs bzhin nyams su blangs chog mod la/ 'on kyang*/ sngon lo chen rin bzang rgyud sde thams cad kyi lha khang thog rim pa can du bzhengs te nyin re bzhin 'og thog nas rim pa ltar so so'i nyams len sgrigs chags mdzad pa la jo bo rje byon tshe/ rgyud sde tha dad kyi mkhyen rgya la thugs mgu yang thams cad gcig dril du nyams 360)su len ma shes pa thugs khril bas/ slar lo chen gyi gcig dril nyams su blangs thabs zhus nas bsgom pas mkha' spyod 'grub tshul gyi lo rgyus ltar lags pa dang*/ gzhan yang*/ ji skad du/ ye shes lha la rang rgyud kyi// rtsis gdab 'grigs su bcad pa med// gang ltar mos pa de ltar snang*/ zhes dang*/ sangs rgyas gar mkhan bsam mi khyab/ ces sogs kyi lung ltar yin te/ dper na/ rnam 'joms dang phyag rdor gnyis ni mtshan gyi bye brag tsam yin tshe/ rnam par 'joms pa bya rgyud kyi lhar grags kyang bla med kyi dkyil 'khor la yod pa yang mang zhing*/ las bum gyi lhar rnam 'joms khro bor bstan tshe bdud rtsi 'khyil par brjod pa dang*/ de bzhin du/ rigs gsum mgon po bya rgyud kyi lha'i gtso bo yin kyang*/ rnal 'byor rgyud dang rnal 'byor bla med rgyud thams cad du ma khyab pa med pa ltar dang*/

sgrol ma yang rgyud sde phal cher gyi lhar bzhugs shing*/ mdo lugs kyi sher phyin dang 361)sngags spyi'i sgrol ma dang*/ bla med du phag mo sogs don du gcig pas na/ dbye ba dka' mi dgos la/ gnas skabs tha dad kyi bsgom lugs ni rang rang gi sgrub thabs bzhin byas pas 'grub pa lags/ ༈ yang*/ chu gtor dang bsangs kyi bdag bskyed sogs la bskyed rim gyi yan lag tshang pa'i spro bsdu ma byung gsungs pa ni/ spyir bdag mdun bum skyed kun gyi bskyed rim rgyas pa'i skabs su na de nyid kyi sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang ba zhig dang*/ skyed tshul dngos kyang*/ mngon byang lnga/ cho ga gsum/ rdo rje bzhi sogs kyi bskyed cing*/ bsnyen bsgrub yan lag bzhi ldan gyi sgo nas bsgrub tshul dang*/ mjug bsdud kyi las rim rnams tshang bar dgos na'ang*/ bsangs dang chu gtor sogs thun mtshams kyi chos spyod kun la ni gong du smos pa bzhin yi dam gyi nga rgyal dang ma bral ba'i ngang nas bya ba yin rung*/ yi dam lha'i ngo bo la khyad med kyang gnas skabs ltar 362)snang tsam du/ las gang byed de dang mthun pa'i lha skad cig dran rdzogs su gsal zhigang bsgyur ba ni gang 'dul sprul bsgyur gyi 'gro don byed/ phrin las yin pa dang*/ de lta bu la ni bskyed rim gyi las chog thams cad tshang bar sgrigs chags su dgos pa ma lags so/ ༈ thugs srog sa bon bsgom pa'i yi ge'i gdong ngam mdun gang la brtsi gsungs pa ni/ de ni dpe cha'i yig mgo la blta ba de ma lags te/ rang la blta ba 'di kho na la bzhed cing*/ 'di skabs/ rnying ma'i btags grol sogs 'ga' re'i he ru ka rigs lnga yab yum zhal sbyar mtshon pa'i hūm̐ gnyis sgrig ma la gcig drang po dang gcig kha log tu 'bri ba yod pa/ mtshon byed rtags kyi yi ge tsam yin na'ang*/ 'ga' zhig gi hūm̐ gnyis po klog lugs kyang mi 'dra bar byed mkhan snang ba ni mi

363)mkhas pa'i mkhas 'dod du zad la/ lar/ sngags 'phreng bskor tshul sogs la'ang so so'i bzhed pa mi mthun pa sna tshogs snang mod kyi/ gsar ma'i phag mo lha khrid kyi steng spro 'og spro sogs dang*/ rnying ma'i 'gal me skor tshul sogs kyi dger don du ni sngags 'bru gcig gi zhabs su gcig gi dbu 'thud pa'i lu gu rgyud du byed dgos pa sogs tha dad yod na'ang*/ gzhan spyi 'gro la ni/ ma ṇi rdo 'bum la yod tshul ltar byed pa shas che zhing*/ de yang a 'thas kha lta phyogs gcig kho nar mi bzung ste/ ting 'dzin ye shes kyi rnam rol yin tshe phyogs gang nas bltas kyang kha phyogs log pa sogs ma yin par mdun 'ba' shig snang bar byed pa lags/ bskyed rim gyi brda don rtags gsum gang la zer gsungs pa gsum/ 'di ni spyir rnying lugs kyi chos skad du gda' bas gsar ma la grags chung na'ang*/ rje don ldan zhabs kyi phag mo'i gzhung du/ brda don rtags gsum gyi phag mo 364)dbye ba mdzad pa dang dgongs pa gcig nyid lags te/ de ka la mtshon na/ brda'i phag mo ni lte ba'i tsaṇ+ḍa li/ don gyi phag mo ni sems nyid lhan skyes kyi ngo bo/ rtags kyi phag mo ni sku mdog phyag mtshan sogs kyi rnam par ji ltar bsgom pa'i bskyed rim dngos te/ de gsum la ngos 'dzin pa yin tshul ni dgongs par los mnga' la/ rnying lugs ltar na'ang*/ snod bcud phung khams skyed mched sogs gdod nas lhar grub pa ni brda/ de'i rang bzhin gsal stong gnyis su med pa ni don/ don de rtogs shing mngon gyur du bya phyir rnam pa gsal bar bskyed pa ni rtags te/ de gsum ga yang rang sems kyi rnam rol las ni ma 'das so/ 'di la rtags dang brda gnyis sbyor sa go brje ba yang yod pa dang*/ bsdu na mtshon byed dpe'i bskyed rim dang*/ mtshon bya don gyi bskyed rim gnyis la yang 'du ste/ blos bsgom pa ni dpe/

gdod nas grub pa'i don yin phyir/ 'dus byas dang 'dus ma byas gnyis 365)sam/ kun rdzob don dam mam/ gzugs sku chos sku sogs kyi don lags te/ o rgyan rin po ches/ rtags kyi sangs rgyas longs spyod rdzogs sku dang*// don gyi sangs rgyas chos sku gang yin pa// chos nyid rig pa mngon sum nyid yin pas// sangs rgyas gzhan nas ma 'tshol rje 'bangs rnams/ zhes gsungs pa ltar yin tshe/ sems nyid kyi rang bzhin rig na bskyed rim gyi brda don rtags gsum ngang gis tshang ba ni/ ji skad du/ spros pa med pa'i rang bzhin la// lha dang sngags ni yang dag gnas/ ces pa ltar lags/ ༈ de ltar bskyed rdzogs rim can du bsgom tshul ni/ gang zag las dang po pa rnams 'khrid thabs dgongs nas so sor gsungs pa ma gtogs/ yang dag pa'i don la ni nam yang zung 'jug kho na las ma g.yos pa ste/ kun rdzob ltar snod kyi 'jig rten dang bcud kyi sems can thams cad kyang med bzhin snang ba'i cho 'phrul rmi lam gyi yul snang lta bu ste/ gshis stong pa nyid dang*/ gdangs 'gag pa med pa/ 366)de gnyis kyang tshig la tha dad du brjod kyang don la gnyis su ma grub pa'i zung 'jug 'ba' shig yin pa dang*/ lam pa'i rnal 'byor pa la yang bskyed rim lha'i 'khor lo/ rdzogs rim stong nyid ye shes la sogs rnam grangs ji snyed brjod kyang*/ gzhi lam 'bras gsum nam gyi dus na'ang*/ gshis ma grub pa stong par cham me/ gdangs ma 'gag pa gsal bar lam me/ ngo bo gnyis med zung 'jug tu 'khrig ge ba las nam yang ma g.yos la/ snang ba'i cha thams cad yi dam yab kyi rang bzhin/ stong pa'i cha thams cad yum gyi rang bzhin/ snang stong tha mi dad pa ni yab yum zung 'jug de ni rnal 'byor pa'i sems dang dbyer med pa nyid do/ de ltar rtogs tshe/ sems nyid 'gag med kyi 'char sgo thams cad thabs skyed rim gyi rang bzhin/ ngo bo stong nyid kyi gnas tshul thams cad shes rab rdzogs rim gyi rang bzhin/

de gnyis ni gser dang ser po'am/ tsan+dan dang dri/ me dang drod/ chu dang rlan lta bu ye nas zung 'jug kho na ma gtogs/ chu dang phye bsres nas zan 367)gyi ngo bor bzos pa lta bu blo bur du byas shing bcos pa ni ma yin no/ 'o na rgyud dang man ngag rnams su bskyed rdzogs so sor bstan pa gang yin zhe na/ rgyal ba thabs la mkhas pas gdul bya blo dman rnams la thugs rjes dgongs te dang por so so la bslabs pas mthar zung 'jug tu rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/ kun rdzob lam du byas nas don dam mngon du byed pa bskyed rim dang*/ don dam lam du byas nas kun rdzob mngon du byed pa rdzogs rim zhes sogs bstan na'ang*/ mthar thug gi don la ni/ gzhi bden gnyis zung 'jug 'bras bu sku gnyis zung 'jug nyid la rgyal bas gsungs pa'i chos thams cad 'du mod kyi/ de lta bur ma rtogs log rtogs phyogs rtogs kyi dbang du gyur pa dag ni gang zag gi rang skyon du zad mod/ don ji bzhin rtogs pa rnam la bskyed rdzogs gnyis po zung 'jug tu lhun gyis grub par mchis so/ ༈ yang*/ bskyed rdzogs gnyis 368)ka stan thog gcig tu ma tshang na nyes pa ci lta bu yod gsungs pa ni/ de yang rdzogs rim gyis ma zin pa'i bskyed rim ni blos byas kun btags yin pas/ des ni gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu thun mong gi dngos grub tsam 'byung srid na'ang*/ mthar thug rdzogs byang gi 'bras bu la mi nye ste/ ji skad du/ rgyan dang cha lugs gsal gyur kyang*// lha ni rang rgyud par bsgom na// gzung 'dzin 'khrul pa'i blo yin pas// mkha' la rgyu ba'i rigs can gyi// lha'am 'byung po'i rigs su gol/ zhes dang*/ yang*/ snang cha'am gsal cha ye mi 'dod par mi rtog stong rkyang kho na bsgom pa ni 'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug tu gol zhing*/ thabs kyi ma zin pas sangs rgyas lam du mi 'gyur ba'i tshul ni/ lha nyid gsal bar mi sgom zhing*// bsod nams tshogs ni ma rdzogs na// ye shes tshogs chen mi rdzogs te// gzugs med khams kyi lha ru skye// de

369)bas snang stong gnyis med kyi// gnas lugs ye shes chos kyi sku// gsal dag bde ba chen po'i skur// zung 'jug yon tan dran pas bsgom// mi dmigs las byung bskyed rim dang*// bskyed pa dmigs med rdzogs rim ste// gnyis med rnam par gnas pa ni// rdo rje 'chang gi chos nyid do/ zhes gsungs pas/ thabs shes rim gnyis tshang bar nyams su ma blangs na sangs rgyas mi 'grub ste/ bya nam mkhar 'phur ba yang 'dab gshog tshang dgos pa ltar lags mod kyi/ tshul 'di la lung mang yang yig tshogs la 'dzem ste ma bris so/ ༈ de nas yang rdzogs rim gtso bor gyur pa'i 'phros don las nang don gyi lung 'dren gnang nas/ skabs don snying por/ rtsa a wa dhu ti lus can kun gyi srog rtsar gsungs na/ 'gro ba drug ka la yod mod dang*/ bar do'i sems can 'gro ba drug la gtogs ma gtogs sogs kyi dri ba gnang ba ni/ spyir lus can thams cad srog gis 370)bsdus pa yin phyir srog gi rlung tsam ni yod par 'dod dgos na'ang*/ gzugs med gyi lha sogs la khyab pa'i nges pa bsgrub dka' zhing*/ lar yang*/ khams drug ldan pa mi'i lus kho na dang de las kyang 'dzam gling ma gtogs gzhan la rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi rten du mi rung bar gsungs pas na/ rtsa thig rlung gsum tshang ba ni mi kho na lags shing*/ 'gro ba gzhan rnams dbyibs dang kha dog tha dad pa'i dbang gi rtsa gsum 'khor lo drug sogs bshad pa'i don yang ma mchis pa ste/ dper na chu la gnas pa'i nya'i rigs rnams kyi snying ni mgo'i nang yod pa rgyud sde nas gsung phyir/ de ltar na 'khor lo lnga rim pa dag kyang bzhad gad kyi gnas su 'gyur mod kyi/ des na srog rtsa sogs kyang 'gro ba mi'i lus can kho na la 'chad pa nyid 'thad par sems so/ ༈ bar srid pa'i 'gro ba rnams kyang 'gro drug la 'du bar bzhed de/ 371)skye ba phyi ma'i mngal du ma chud kyi bar la skye ba snga ma de nyid kyi cha shas yin pa'i phyir dang*/

'on kyang 'jig rten bdun po zhabs kyi mnan te/ zhes sogs kyi skabs su ni/ 'gro ba drug gi steng du gshin rje'i 'jig rten dang bdun du 'dren pa ste/ gshin rje'i 'jig rten ni bar srid la 'jug par bzhed do/ ༈ yang*/ nang don nas gsungs pa'i mngal gyi gnas skabs/ mkhrang gyur zhag ni dang po nas// rang sor phyer dang bcu gsum gyi// tshad ldan dbu ma srog rlung bcas/ ces chags tshul gyi skabs der nyid kyi/ de dus yan lag gi rnam pa tsam yang ma 'grub pa la/ so sor bgrang pa'i thabs ma mchis gsungs pa la/ 'di'i dgongs pa ni/ spyir gling bzhi'i mi so so'i lus tshad tha dad pa mngon pa sogs nas gsungs pa las/ 'dzam bu gling pa rnams tshe lo dang bsod nams dang lus tshad rnams rim gyi bri ba las/ da ltar spyir rang khru bzhi dang*/ 372)gzugs ngan rnams las rang khru phyed dang bzhi/ zhes bshad rgyud nas gsungs pa bzhin yin pa dang*/ sor mo bcu gnyis sam phyed dang bcu gsum la rang mtho gang dang*/ mtho do la khru gang du bshad cing*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku tshad la sor brgya nyer lnga/ sa gnas kyi byang sems rnams la brgya nyi shu/ nyan rang sogs la brgya dang dgu so skyes phal pa 'dom gang gru bzhi mnyam pa'i lus chu zheng gab pa la sor dgu bcu go drug dang*/ gzhan mchu zheng mnyam pa dkon phyir/ yas man la brgyad bcu rgya bzhi dang*/ phan tshun gyi 'dom la dgu bcu rtsa drug yin par gsungs pas na/ de'i phyir mkhrang gyur gyis skabs khyab 'jug nya'i rnam pa'i lus tshad gang yod pa de ka'i brgyad cha gcig la kho rang gi rang sor bcu gnyis sam phyed dang bcu gsum du rtsi dgos pa dang*/ lar 'di skabs su/ nang don las ni dus 'khor dang mthun par 'khor lo lnga'i bar thag tu sor mo phyed dang bcu gsum du gsungs la/ 373)rgyud sde la la nas ni/ skyes bu lus tshad rdzogs pa la de ltar yin kyang*/ de skabs lus chag tshad la rdzogs pa'i dbang gis/

'khor lo rnams kyi bar thug la rang sor brgyad brgyad du bshad pa yang gda' lags/ yang*/ srog rtsa dang dbu ma gcig mi gcig dri ba gnang ba'i skabs/ rgyal ba yang dgon pa'i rdo rje lus kyi sbas bshad du/ rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud las/ srog gi dbyug pa'i nang gnas pa/ zhes sogs kyi lung khungs de rnal 'byor rgyud la bla med kyi tshig 'di 'ong mi thang gsungs pa la/ tshig 'di'i lung khungs rnal 'byor yo ga'i rgyud ma lags te/ rnal 'byor chen po zhes pa gsang sngags nang pa bla med kyi skabs kho nar 'jug phyir/ rnying ma'i lugs la theg pa rim dgur bgrang pa'i tshe yang*/ nyan rang byang sems gsum theg dman dang theg chen te mtshan nyid theg pa/ bya spyod rnal 'byor gsang sngags phyi pa/ ma hā yo ga a nu yo ga a ti yo ga 374)gsum gsang sngags nang pa bla med yin phyir/ ma hā yo ga bod skad du bsgyur na rnal 'byor chen po zer ba lags tshe/ de la rgyud kyi rtsa ba tan+t+ra sde bco brgyad/ de dag gi yan lag rgyud sde mtha' yas pa dang*/ gsar ma'i bde dgyes gsang 'jigs dus 'khor sogs thams cad rgyud sde 'di dag gi nang mtshan lags mod kyi/ des na gong 'og gi lung 'dren de ni phyag chen thig le kha sbyor gyi rgyud tshig tu gda' lags/ srog rtsa dang dbu ma gcig gam tha dad pa ni/ spyir bzhed pa mi gcig pa du mar 'byung ba ni/ rgyal ba 'jig rten mkhyen pas gzigs pa yin tshe gdul bya'i khams dbang tha dad sna tshogs pa'i ngor rgyud sde yang tha dad pa du ma'i 'chad tshul mi 'dra ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ ji ltar snod kyi bzo dbyibs tha dad pa'i nang gi nam mkha'i dbyibs kyang tha dad la/ snod chag pa'i shul na ni nam mkha'i dbyibs tha dad mi 'byung ba lta bu'i dpe ltar/ 'khor 'das kyi chos rnams rang gi ngo bo ngos bzung dang 375)bral yang*/ kun rdzob kyi snang tshul tsam du gang yang 'char zhing*/

shar ba nyid bden grub tu ma yin pa'i tshul rnams ma go na/ gzhung tha dad pa'i 'gal 'du la a 'thas su bzung na byis pa nam mkha'i mtha' rgya la rtsod pa ltar 'gyur ba ste/ des na/ rang nyid gang la nyams su len pa de'i lugs nyid dbang btsan par bya zhing*/ gzhan lugs rnams kyang blo'i ra bar shong bar byed pa 'di ni chos thams cad kyi sgo 'byed pa'i lde mig dam pa lags par dgongs 'tshal/ zhes sngon du gsol nas/ bye brag gi skabs don la/ srog pa rtsa dang dbu ma gnyis rags pa'i dbang du ni gcig par gsungs phyir zab mo nang don las kyang gcig tu gsungs pa nyid lags pa dang*/ de dag gi don phra zhib kyi dbang ltar na/ mchog gi dbu ma dang*/ mchog ma yin pa'i dbu ma dang*/ srog rtsa nyid dang*/ ro rkyang gnyis dang lnga po 376)la ye shes kyi rtsa rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i dbyibs yin par bshad pa yang yod la/ dbu ma gnyis po thabs kyi dbu ma dang shes rab kyi dbu ma'am/ yab dang yum gyi dbu ma zhes su grags shing*/ don du srog rtsa las gyes pa'i bye brag yin par bzhed pa dang*/ gnas tshul ni/ srog rtsa'i nang la nang bcug lta bur bzhed pa'i lugs gcig dang*/ srog rtsa'i mdun du yod par bzhed pa'i lugs gcig kyang yod pa ste/ de gnyis gang ltar yang dbu ma mchog de ni snang la rang bzhin ma grub pa'i tshul gyi phyi gsal nang gsal 'od kyi rnam pa lta bu srog rtsa dang sbubs gcig tu 'brel bar gsungs pa dang*/ chu shing ltar drang ba mtshan nyid bzhi ldan dang*/ yar mar gyi rtsa sna sogs zug tshul 'brel tshul rnams nang don sogs nas ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin dang*/ dkar dmar sogs gsum gyi gnas tshul yang de bzhin te/ 'di'i ming gi rnam grangs rnams kyi zhib cha 377)dang bcas pa dag ni nang don dang sbas bshad las gsungs pa de dag las lhag pa 'dir brjod ma dgos la/ sum bcu rtsa gnyis mdud dang ldan pa ni ro rkyang gnyis po dbu mar 'khril tshul re la mdud pa'i grangs su brjod cing*/

mchog ma yin pa'i dbu ma ni de'i yan lag yin no/ srog rlung a yig gi tshul du gnas pa yang bod yig gi a sum khyog 'di ma yin par/ a shad kyi rnam pas rang gang du yod par bzhed pa mang ba dang*/ khyad par skal bzang dga' byed du bshad pa'i rnam shes tshogs brgyad kyi rtsa ba'i 'chad tshul de ni rnying ma'i sgyu 'phrul chen po'i rgyud sde rnams kyi lugs ltar yin zhing*/ gsar ma ltar na/ sbas bshad du yon tan gyi rtsa khyi mo nyal 'dra zhes pa de dang yang 'brel gcig par sems la/ ngo khro 'grel chen du ni 'di dang bha san+tu sogs la dgag pa mdzad 'dug rung*/ rgyud sde tha dad kyi dgongs pa yin tshe dgag 378)pa mdzad pa po ngal bar zad do/ mdor na tshogs brgyad kyi rtsa 'di rnams dang nang don sogs nas gsungs pa'i rtsa dbu ma gsum/ yan lag {gsum sgor pa/ 'dod pa/ 'gyi gam/ gtum mo/ bdud 'dul ma/}lnga ste brgyad po rnams dang ngo bo gcig la/ 'di rnams dbu ma'i rtsa 'dabs su yod cing*/ rin chen cod paṇa dang mgon po chen po sogs sum cu rtsa gnyis so/ phyi 'dab yin par bshad do/ sbas pa'i rtsa lnga sogs kyi rtsa yig rnams kyang rgyud sde tha dad par mi mthun tshul sbas bshad du zhib par mchis shing*/ yang*/ bha san+tu dang ri bong mig zhes pa gcig la/ ka ti shel sbyag dang 'di gnyis po rtsa ba gcig la rtse mo tha dad gyes te mig gnyis la zug pa dang*/ de'i yan lag gi cha shas gcig lce'u chung zug pa'i mdud bral ma de yin par bshad/ lce'u chung ni phal skad du lce rkyal zer ba'i 'og gi rtsa ba 'di la 'dod do/ 379)nyid kyis/ sgo lnga'i rnam shes kyi phyi ma de ma go gsungs pa ni/ lus kyi rnam shes ces bya ba reg bya'i yul 'dzin mkhan gyis shes pa de yin mod kyi/ de'i rtsa gcig mdud bral ma 'di yin par gsungs la/ reg bya'i rtsa bran/ gzhan ni ba spu'i grangs mnyam yin pas bsam gyis mi khyab bo/

ka ti shel sbug gi bye brag gzhan yang*/ rdzogs chen gyi snang min gnyis kyi nyams len skabs tshor ni rtsa'i bye brag gzhan thams cad btang snyoms su bzhag nas/ dbu ma'i yal 'dabs kyi rtsa phra la 'khril dar dkar rnal ma/ gser gyi rtsa chen/ stong pa rang grol/ ka rti she sbug ste/ ye shes lnga'i rtsa 'dab rnams kyi rgyas bshad yod rung skabs 'dir brjod don chung mod kyi/ mdor na gong du smos pa bzhin gdams pa gang nyams su len pa de'i gzhung don dang sbyar ba ma gtogs mtha' dag gis gnas 380)tshul ni bsam par mi nus so/ yang*/ mi shig pa'i dpyid kyi thig le'i dwangs ma lnga 'dus kyi skabs 'di la rgyud ste spyi mthun du ni/ sha yis dwangs ma dbu ma'i rtsa// khrag gi dwangs ma a thung me// rus pa'i dwangs ma thig le haṃ// dbugs kyi dwangs ma srog gi rlung*// yid kyi dwangs ma kun gzhi sems/ zhes pa 'di nang don gzhung 'grel sogs phal cher dogangs pa mthun la/ lnga 'dus kyi thig le dngos bstan snying gar yod tshul bshad pa 'di la mu stegs pa'i lugs dang 'dres dgos snang yang*/ rnying lugs 'od gsal thod brgal gyis gzhung mtha' dag tu ni gong du smos pa'i dwangs ma lnga po 'di dag gi dwangs ma'i dwangs ma 'od kyi thig le'i rnam par yod tshul nan gyis gsungs shing*/ kun tu kha sbyor gyi rgyud tshig snying ga'i dbus gyur pad+mo ni/ zhes sogs 381)kyi lung de dang sbyar nas/ rtsa mchog de nyid kha gyen la bsgyur bas dwangs ma lnga 'dus kyi yon tan spel thabs rgya cher gsungs pa yod cing*/ de dag mthun pa sbas bshad du yang snang mod/ lar rgyal ba yang dgon pa de nyid rje rang byung gi ltar/ nang rdo rje lus kyi snang tshul ji lta bar gzigs shing*/ gzhan yang rin chen rnam bzhi la brten nas gsar ma'i gdams ngag zab dgu dang*/ mi skyod pa dang phul mar ba sogs las rnying ma'i gdams pa rnams kyi sgro 'dogs bcad pa'i mthus gsung 'bum spyi dang khyad par sbas bshad skor rnams shin tu mtha' rgya chod pa snang bar sems lags shing*/

des na gong du smos pa ltar/ chos rang rang gi skabs don gyi dbang gis thams cad gcig tu mthun pa zhig ni gdams ngag gang la yang mi 'byung ngo*/ yang*/ gong gi tshogs brgyad kyi rtsa'i nang tshan ye shes kyi rtsa de la nyon mongs 382)pa'i dri ma yod dam med/ gsungs pa de ni/ spyir nyon mongs dang ye shes ni gsang sngags su lam du lhongs ma lhongs kyi skyon yon tsam las ngo bo tha dad du mi 'dod pa dang*/ khyad par tha mal pa'am lam pa'i rnal 'byor gyi skabs la nyon mongs kyi dri ma yod par gor ma chags la/ nam zhig nyams len gyi 'bras bu mngon du gyur tshe ni/ rtsa thig rlung sems mtha' dag ye shes kyi rang bzhin du dag tshe nyon mongs kyi dri ma shul du lus rgyu ni ga la mchis lags shing*/ da lta ye shes kyi rtsa ming du brjod pa ni ye shes 'char ba'i rten gnas min pa ma dgongs pa'o/ lar yang gsar ma'i bde dgyes gsang gsum dang dus 'khor rnams su 'di dag gi ming dang gnas tshul cung zhig mi 'dra ba 'byung ba ltar/ rnying ma'i ma hā a nu a ti'i rgyud sde so sor 'chad lugs mi gcig pas na/ phyi nang gzhan gsum gyi tshul mtha' dag ye shes kyi gzigs pas 383)mngon sum par gyur pa'i skyes chen rnams ma gtogs/ rang cag gi spyod yul ma yin mod cing*/ rgyud 'grel mang po'i rab 'byams smra bar zhal gyis bzhes pa dag kyang*/ gyi ling zhar ba'i 'gros ltar phyogs ltar phyogs rer cung zad 'khyog pa mang bar gda' bas na/ rmongs rgan bdag 'dra bas yig cha re re gnyis gnyis la bltas pas blun tshod 'dir bris pa'i dgos pa gang yang ma mchis shing*/ skal bzang dga' byed du tshogs brgyad kyi rtsa'i dbus ma gsum chos nyid kyi rtsa zhes pa de yang rtsa gtso bo gsum las gzhan ni ma lags kyang*/ brjod bya 'gam ma gtsang bas nyid kyi dgongs par 'byor dka' ba shin tu nas thugs bden la/ de dag gi skabs kyi 'gro ba drug gi gnas sbyong gi yi ge dang sku gsum gyi snying po sogs kyi 'chad tshul de yang lugs gcig kho na'i 'chad lugs yin pa ma gtogs/

gzhan la de dang mi mthun 384)pa'i 'chad tshul mtha' yas pa gzhung so sor yod phyir mtha' gcig tu 'dzin rgyu ni ma lags so/ nā ṭi dbu mar rengs pa zhes gsungs pa'i nā ṭi de srog gi rlung yin shas che yang*/ skad dod kyi yig cha bye brag rtogs byed sogs su ni ma mthong la/ lar yang*/ gsang sngags kyi mtha' drug tshul bzhis bcings pa'i ming 'di 'dra'i mtha' chod par dka' ba dang*/ log pa dang rengs pa gnyis gcig gam tha dad gsungs pa/ spyir ni rlung gi gnad ma 'chun pa'i gegs skyon kun la rlung log ces par grags mod kyang*/ bye brag tu ni mi gcig par gsungs te/ rlung log pa ni rgyu ba'i lam de las go zlog pa'am/ gnas min gyi lam du shor ba yin la/ rengs pa ni/ dper na dgun gyi tshe bum pa la sogs pa'i snod kyi chu mkhregs 385) las su mi rung zhing snod kyang chud zos su 'gyur ba lta bu la 'jug pa ste/ log rengs gnyis kyi gegs sel yang tha dad du gda' lags mod/ rtsa bcu po'i ming dang ngos 'dzin sogs rgyud gzhan nas gsungs pa dang*/ dus 'khor nas ser skya phra mo lus srog gi ming don phan tshun sbyor dka' bar snang gsungs pa de ni/ rang 'grel nyid las cung zad zhib pa tsam ngo khro'i 'grel par dri med 'od kyi lung dang bcas te snang bas der gzigs pa zhu zhing*/ gzhan yang*/ las dang ye shes kyi rlung gi 'gro ldog dang lo gsum phyogs gsum gyi rnam gzhag mnyam dang mi mnyam pa'i khyim gyi 'pho 'jug phyi nang gnyis kyi nyi zlar sgra gcan gyi 'jug tshul sogs 386)kyi rnam dbye zhib pa gcig bgyis na phral yun gyi blo gsal mang por phan par 'gyur tshul gyis bka' phebs pa'i cha la/ spyir bdag thog ma nas shes rab kyi stobs rtsal dman zhing thos bsam gyi bsags pa dang mi ldan/ dgos su gsang sngags gsar ma'i gzhung lugs dang dus 'khor rgyud 'grel sogs la 'dris goms chung ba dang*/

nang don yang bklag lung tsam las gzhan pa'i 'grel bshad zhib pa ni ma thob pa dang*/ lho brag sras mkhar sogs su bsdad skabs kyang*/ skyabs gnas de nyid bdag 'drar thugs rjes gzigs tshul ni gzhan dang mi 'dra ba zhig yod cing*/ de skabs phyag phyir yang mdo sngags kyi chos la dbang 'byor ba'i mkhas grub tshar du dngar ba gda' na'ang*/ rang nyid bsod nams dman te dgon chung rnams kyi gnyer khung rang thog tu babs ba'i rkyen gyis/ zhabs phyir yun du sdod dbang ma byung bas thos bsam gyis yal 'dab ma rgyas 387)pa'i ngang nas lang tsho'i me tog yol ba zhig byung ba'i rgyu las/ bka' phebs pa gnad don 'di dag smra ba'i nus pas dben phyir/ des na/ sku nyid nang don gyi bdag por snang bas mi mkhyen mi gzigs pa'i cha tsam mi 'byung mod la/ spyir yang*/ gtsug lag 'phreng ba'i gsung las ni/ nang don gyis 'grel pa phyis byung ba la ni 'khas grub dwags ram pa chos rgyal bstan pas mdzad pa de las legs pa mi 'dug ces gsungs pa snang kyang bdag gis ni phyi rting las ma mjal/ ngo khro 'grel chen ni rgyu'i theg pa'i bshad pa rgya cher gnang ba tsam las/ gzhung don nyid ni rang 'grel las zhib pa zhig gnang yod mdog mi kha bar sems lags pa dang*/ rnying ma'i lugs la ni/ slob dpon rin po ches gsungs pa'i gter chos phal cher du rtsa thig rlung gsum gyis gdams pa rgyas bsdus bsam mi khyab pa 388)mchis pa'i nang nas/ rang nyid kyis mthong ba la ni bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa'i nang gi lam 'bras chen mo rtsa rlung rdo rje drwa mig gi chos skor nyid kho na legs par go zhing*/ de'i dngos po'i gnas lugs 'chad pa'i skabs rnams ni yang dgon pa'i sbas bshad dang shin tu mthun par yod pa dang*/ gzhan yang*/ yang dgon pa'i ri chos zhes ding sang 'brug lugs sogs la rlung ltar grags pa de yang*/ mnga' bdag myang gi gter chos kyi khrod na/

pad+ma lam rim zhes pa de dang zhus dag pher la khad du yod tshe/ des na/ o rgyan sprul pa yang dgon rgyal ba 'byung*/ zhes lung bstan 'ga' la 'dug pa de yang shin tu bden nam zhes rang nyid kho na sems lags/ ces 'phros don du gsol ba dang*/ snying po'i gsol 'bras/ bdag tsho ni gsar rnying gi khrid skor gang zhus rnams kyi zhar las 'ongs pa'i thabs lam gyi rigs mang zhig thob thob tu bgrang ba tsam las/ blo'i 389)gtod yul ni rdzogs chen skor gyi man ngag rnams las 'byung ba ltar/ rtsa thams cad kyi ye shes kyi rtsa chos dbyings spros bral/ rlung thams cad ye shes kyi rlung rig pa rang gsal/ thig le thams cad bde chen ye shes kyi thig le ma bcos khyab gdal chen por 'dus pa'i nyams len gcig pur dril khul tsam las gzhan pa'i nyams myong gi dben phyir nang don sogs kyis dgongs 'grel rgyas par 'bul ba'i nus pa ma mchis lags/ ༈ yang 'pho ba'i skabs don gyi dri ba gnang ba'i char/ pha rol po'i lus dang rang lus gnyis ka lhar gsal dgos sam mi dgos gsungs pa ni/ spyir 'pho ba'i gdams pa yang lugs mi 'dra ba shin tu mang phyir/ rang nyid gang gi lugs la gom pa de ka dang mthun par byed dgos par gzhir 390)bcas la/ rang lus lhar bsgom na byin rlabs che bar yod shas che yang*/ 'di skabs nges par bsgom dgos pa ru ni ma gsungs/ pha rol po yang bskyed rim sogs go rtogs 'phrod pa zhig yin pa'am/ khyad par sngar nas bskyed rim gyi 'pho ba byang ba zhig yin na ma gtogs/ gzhan de skabs lhar gsal ba sogs kyi dmigs pa mang na mi zin pas don mi 'grub tshe/ lus stong ra'i nang du dbu ma yang 'di skabs rag dung gyen la bstan pa lta bu tsam la bsdu ba ma gtogs rlung sogs bsgom dus kyi dmigs pa ltar dbu ma mtshan nyid bzhi ldan sogs kyi zhib cha mang po ni de dus rang dbang mi 'dus bas/ dmigs pa mdor bsdu ba zhig kho na gal che ba/

kho'i rnam shes kyi ngo bo yang gzhung so so'i khyad kyis lha sku/ yig 'bru/ phyag mtshan/ 'od kyi thig le sogs bsgom tshul sna tshogs 'byung mod kyi/ pha rol po yi ge mi shes mkhan yin 391)na ni hūm̐ sogs yig 'bru'i dmigs pa ni sprod thabs kyang mi 'byung bas gzhan gang 'thad tsam dang*/ gtso bor 'di ni rnam shes 'thon pa'i sgo kha nas khyad par du byed pa yin phyir/ khyed rang gi rig pa spyi gtsug kho nar gtod/ zer ba tsam gyis ni khyad par che bar yod par gsungs shing*/ kho rang gang la mos pa'i bla ma de nyid spyi bor bsgom du bcug nas mos gus gdung shugs kyis de'i thugs kar sems rtse gcig tu gtad du bcug la/ rang gis kyang gsol 'debs dang smon lam gzungs sngags byin rlabs can dang sangs rgyas kyi mtshan bsgrags pa sogs kho'i mgo phyogs nas gsal dag snyan pas bya zhing*/ spyi gtsug las gzhan pa'i khyad par smad phyogs la mi reg par bya ba ni thams cad la gal che bar gsungs pas/ dud 'gro yan chod la yang de tsam gyis kyang phan par bshad yod/ rnam shes spar rjes bskyed rim bsdu 392)ba sogs ni dgos pa'i gnas med do/ rang nyid ni pha rol po la dmigs pa sprod mkhan dang bsgom mkhan byed pa lta bu tsam ma gtogs rang lus la bsgom rgyu min tshe mnyam du 'pho ba'am tshe la gzan pa sogs kyi dogs pa med lags shing*/ 'pho ba 'debs pa'i nye skor du gnyen 'khor sogs su byung byung tshogs na sngags kyi gsang sgrogs su yang los 'gyur mod la/ gzhan yang der yod rnams kyi mya ngan dang ngu 'bod sogs kyis ni dmigs yul de la gnod tshabs rab tu che tshe de 'dra'i rigs nye bskor gyi phyogs tsam du yang med par byed pa ni gal po cher snang ngo*/ lar nas rnam shes spyi bor 'thon thabs tsam ma gtogs/ 'pho ba tshul ldan thebs par byed pa la sngar nas sbyangs sbyangs pa dang*/ dmigs pa sogs la go rtogs yod mkhan dang dam tshig ma nyams pa zhig ma gtogs/

tha mal pa kun gyis yong bar ma gsungs kyang*/ ding sang gsang sngags 'chal pa'i 393)dbang gis skye bo phal pa shi tshad la 'pho ba'i dmigs pa 'debs pa 'di bzhin dar snang yang*/ don tshul bzhin 'grub pa ni ma thos la/ 'debs pa'i dus mtshams yang*/ phyi dbugs chad nas nang dbugs ma chad pa'i bar der gdab dgos par gsungs na/ ding sang ni phung po la bzo bcos thug reg mang du byas rjes 'pho ba 'debs mod kyang*/ phung po bsgul skyod byas na rnam shes 'thon 'gro bas/ slar 'pho ba btab pa'i don ma mchis lags tshe/ gang ltar/ ding sang gi phyag len ci la bltas kyang chos kyi gzhung nas gsungs pa dang mthun pa zhig rang gzhan su la'ang dkon par zad do/ yang 'pho ba sbyangs ba'i rigs la ni/ la lar rlung bum can rab 'bring tha gsum gang rung mi nus na mi sbyong par bshad 'dug kyang*/ de'i nges pa ni mi snang ste/ rnying lugs kyi 'pho ba'i khrid rnams su rlung ci yang med pas kyang 'pho ba'i rtags thon 394)te tshangs bug tu 'jag ma tshugs pa ni zhag gsum bzhi las phyir mi 'gyangs par 'dug lags pa ni mngon sum tshad grub ste/ dmigs pa'i zab gnad kyi nus pa yin par ro/ yang*/ thugs dam rdzogs rim gyis skabs kyi 'phros don du/ mar pa'i mgur chen gyi nang gi rtsa ba khyim na gnas pa zhes sogs kyi dgongs don ni nyid rang gis gang gsungs pa de kar 'dug cing*/ kun gzhi'i skabs 'di la/ mdo lugs dang byams chos sogs su bde gshegs snying po'i rnam bshad kyi skabs su/ ji skad du/ snying po de la kun gzhi'i sgras// de bzhin gshegs pas bstan par mdzad// snying po kun gzhir bsgrags pa'i don// blo dman rnams kyi mi shes so/ zhes sogs dang*/ rdzogs chen rnams su ni kun gzhi la yang*/ ye don gyi kun gzhi/ sbyor ba don gyi kun gzhi/ bag chags sna tshogs kyi kun gzhi sogs dbye mod kyang*/ phyag chen gyi skabs 'dir ni spro mi 'tshal zhing*/

395)yid kyi rnam shes btson du bzung ba ni 'khrul pa 'thas su mi 'chor bar byas ba ste/ btson du bzung rgyud nga bzung mkhan tha dad gnyis su yod pa ni ma lags tshe/ rang ngo shes par bya ba nyid dang*/ tshig 'og ma gnyis kyi don ni/ nyid kyis gsungs pa ltar/ rang ngo shes pa de las lhag pa slar bcos ma'i sgom rgyu med pa'i don du snang la/ spyi sdoms ltar na/ stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa sogs sho lo ka gcig gis lta ba'i don bshad/ rtsa ba khyim na gnas pa sogs nas tshig rkang brgyad kyi sgom tshul bshad/ de mthong nas ni sogs tshig drug gis spyod pa bshad/ 'khor ba skyon du mi lta zhing*/ sogs kyi 'bras bu'i don bshad par gda' lags shing*/ de thams cad kyi rtsa ba'i gnad ni/ tha mal shes pa rang lugs de// ma bcos so ma nyid du zhog ces gsungs/ 'di las lhag pa'i sgom ni phyag rdzogs zhi byed gcod yul sbyor drug sogs gang nas kyang ma gsungs so/ 396)yang*/ lhag mthong gi ming 'di cung go dka' ba dang*/ yid la mi byed pa 'di go bde bar gda'/ gsungs pa ni/ zhi lhag gi ming 'di ni spyir mdo sngags gnyis ka'i chos skad yin pa dang*/ khyad par sngags kyi sgom phyogs mtha' dag nas gsungs mod la/ byed las ni/ zhi gnas kyis ni nyon mongs mgo gnon la/ lhag mthong gis ni nyon mongs rtsa ba 'byin/ ces pa ltar dang*/ lhag mthong gi dbye ba gsum bshad pa sogs sgom gyi gzhung thams cad nas rgyas par 'byung mod kyi/ lhag mthong rang gi ngo bo mdzub tshugs su ngos 'dzin na/ da lta'i shes pa brjen pa 'di ka yin phyir/ mnyam par gzhag ma gzhag zhi bar gnas mi gnas/ rtog par 'gyus ma 'gyus sogs tshor mkhan nam rig mkhan 'di ka la lhag mthong zer ba lags/ yid la mi byed pa zhes pa'i skad dod la/ a ma na si ka ra zhes bya ba ste/ mai tri pa nas rgya gar 397)phyag na dang*/ bal po a su sogs la brgyud pa'i chos skor rnams yin zhing*/

rdzogs chen sems sde ba rnams dang phyogs mtshungs par cung zad stong cha che bar bshad pa dang*/ rje mi las rong ston lha dga' las rdzogs chen gsan pa yang sems sde'i rigs yin pas/ grub mtha' gzhan rnams kyis ni chad lta yin pa tsam du 'dzin cing*/ rdzogs chen gong ma rnams las kyang 'di phyogs la stong zhen gyi gol sa cung zad bshad cing*/ deng sang ni rdzogs chen sems phyogs 'di nub nas mi snang la/ gang ltar/ phyag chen gyi yid la mi byed pa 'di dang*/ nyi tshe ba'i stong pa gnyis nor dogs 'dug gsungs pa thugs bden te/ ci yang yid la mi byed do snyam na ni/ de ka yid byed che shos su 'gyur la/ yid la byed mi byed gnyis ka ma dran na ni nyi tshe ba'i stong pa'am dran med kyi gti mug tu 'gyur ba ste/ de gnyis gang yang phyag chen du ma 'gro bas/ 'o na gang yin 398)na/ blos byas kyi yid byed rnam rtog rang ga ma'am/ mtshan bcas kyi dmigs pa'i rigs sogs mdor na yid kyis bcos ma byed dgos pa'i rigs thams cad dor te/ tha mal gyi shes pa'i babs gang shar de ka'i ngang la 'jog pa nyid lags so/ yang*/ hwa shang gi sgom gnyid thug po lta bu dang*/ nang don sogs kyi gnyid stug chos skur gsungs pa de gnyis kyi khyad par gang yin gsungs pa la/ de ni sngon bstan pa snga dar gyi 'jug tu/ mkhan slob chos gsum sogs ma bzhugs pa'i skabs der/ hwa shang ma hā yā nas sgom dkar po gcig thub yin zer ba'i/ dran med nyi tshe ba'i stong pa bsgom lugs bslab ste/ rgyu 'bras blang dor bkag pas/ de'i rjes 'brang mang por gyur nas bstan pa dngos la gnod cing ston min rtsen min du gyes nas bstan pa'i sel du gyur skabs der/ slob dpon ka ma shī la gdan drangs nas hā shang btul zhing sgom 399)rim rnam gsum gyis bstan bcos mdzad pa sogs kyi lo rgyus nas byung ba ltar/ hwa shang gi sgom de ni dran med had po la sgom dngos gzhir 'dod pa ni phyag rdzogs kyi gsal rig stong gsum zung 'jug lam du 'khyer ba 'di dang rgyab 'gal du gyur la/

gnyid thug chos skur bshad pa'i skabs kyi chos skad ni/ gsang sngags su gzhi sems can/ lam rnal 'byor/ 'bras bu sangs rgyas dang bcas pa nam gyi tshe yang sku bzhi'i ngo bo las ma 'das par gsungs pa'i nang tshan gyi/ gnyid thug chos sku/ rmi lam longs sku/ sad pa sprul sku/ snyoms 'jug bde ba chen po'i sku ste/ gnas skabs bzhi dang sku bzhi sbyar ba yin tshe/ rgyu'am gzhi la de ltar yod pa mngon du byed pa la nyams len gyi gnad rnams dgos phyir/ gnyid chos skur byed thabs 'od gsal/ rmi lam longs skur byed pa sgyu lus/ sad pa sprul skur byed pa bskyed rdzogs/ snyoms 400)'jug bde chen du byed pa gtum mo rnams gsungs pa lags mod/ yang byams smon nas gsungs pa'i ting 'dzin rnam pa gsum gyi dri ba gnang ba'i cha la/ spyir/ sangs rgyas byang sems sogs ting 'dzin mngon gyur rnams la ni ting 'jin gcig gi ngang nas ting 'dzin brgya stong mang po'i sgo 'byed pa'i phyir rgyal ba'i yum las gsungs pa ltar ting 'dzin gyi rnam grangs mtha' yas mod la/ skabs 'dir 'phros don la/ chos rgyal khri srong gi dus su slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang ba gangs ti ser byon tshe/ bod la gdan 'dren du btang bas/ kho bo bod la phan thogs mi thogs yi dam lha la 'dri dgos gsungs nas/ mtsho ma pham la gsang 'dus kyi dkyil 'khor sprul nas/ lha thams cad nub tu zhal gzigs pa byung ba na/ kho bo bod du 'gro ba'i rten 'brel mi 'dug gsungs nas rgyal po la chos kyi skyes brdzangs te rgya gar du byon pa'i lo rgyus 'di la/ phyis su rje 'jig rten mgon po'i gsungs nas/ kho bo 401)yin na de dus lha de rnams kyi zhal bod du bsgyur ba la dka' tshegs mi 'ong ste/ ting 'dzin thun gcig gis chog gsungs pa yang thugs bden mod/ ting 'dzin gcig la rang dbang thob na ting 'dzin thams cad thogs pa mi 'byu+ung la/

'on kyang*/ sangs rgyas gsang ba yang dkyil 'khor sprul thub pa la zhal kha bsgyur ma thub par lus dogs med kyang*/ gdul bya'i bskal brten 'brel du bstan par gor ma chags mod/ des na skabs don gyi ting 'dzin gsum po 'di'i rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin ni mdo lugs su sa bcu'i rgyun mtha'i ye shes de yin par gsungs na'ang*/ ye shes de nyid gang la zer na/ thar rgyan du rje mi lha'i gsung lung du drangs te/ ye shes bya ba yang da ltar gyi shes pa bzo bcos ma phog pa 'di la/ yod med rtag chad sogs kyi tshig dang blo las 'das pa 'di rang yin no/ zhes gsungs pa/ ting 'dzin thams cad kyi rtsa ba ni 'di gcig pur 'dus gda' ba dang*/ sgyu ma lta bu'i ting 'dzin ni 'khor 402)'das kyi chos thams cad gang ltar snang yang bden 'dzin dang bral ba dang*/ dpa' bar 'gro ba ni de lta bu'i ngang nas snying rjes sems can gyi don la skyo ba'am ngal dub kyi dbang du mi 'gyur ba'am gzhan gyis gnod pa dang log sgrub sogs kyis mi brdzi ba ste/ de ltar 'chad tshul 'di ni thun mong ba'i lugs yin la/ thun mong ma yin pa sngags kyi lugs ltar na/ pad+ma snying gur brtsegs pa'i rgyud las/ dpa' bar 'gro la snod bcud lhar blta zhing*// sgyu ma lta bu sgra rnams chos kyi dbyangs// rdo rje lta bu rang rig don dam ngang*// ting 'dzin gsum las rgyun du g.yo mi bya/ zhes khyer so gsum la sbyor ba dang*/ yang rnying lugs kyi las gzhung rnams su ni/ gsum po 'di la ming gi rnam grangs su/ de bzhin nyid kyi ting 'dzin/ kun tu snang ba'i ting badzin/ rgyu'i ting 'dzin dang gsum du mdzad de/ gu ru'i las byang rnams su/ dang por chos rnams dmigs med cing*/ smra brjod bral ba'i rdzogs pa che// blo 'das chos 403)sku mi 'gyur na// de bzhin nyid kyi ting 'dzin sgom/ ces pa ni rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin yin la/

blo bral de yi ngang las ni// sems can kun la khyab pa yi// brtse ba'i snying rje chen po bsgom/ zhes kun snang sgyu ma lta bu dang*// stong nyid snying rje'i ngang can gyi/ 'gro don dpag med byed pa'i phyir// rang rig hrīḥlas rdo rjer sgom/ zhes dpa' bar 'gro ba rgyu'i ting 'dzin gyi sgo nas snod bcud lha'i dkyil 'khor skyed tshul rnams 'byung ste/ 'di ltar rnying ma'i las gzhung mtha' dag tu tshig dang lha'i rnam pa tha dad kyang don gyi gsal 'debs ting 'dzin gsum 'di thams cad la gcig par yod do/ yang khyad par phyag rgya chen po'i skabs su ni/ ting 'dzin 'di rnams sbyor lam dang rnal 'byor bzhi la sbyor ba'i tshul ni/ gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rgyud las/ seṅge rnam par bsgyings pa'i ting 'dzin gyis// mi g.yo rtse gcig dwangs pa'i shes pa gsal// rang rig ye shes khong nas sad par 404)byed// bzod pa brtan pos ngan song sdug bsngal spong*// gnyis pa sgyu ma lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis// spros dang bral ba'i mnyam bzhag chen po las// bsam gyis mi khyab ting 'dzin rtsal du shar// drod thob nas ni skye la dbang ba yin// gsum pa dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting 'dzin gyis// du ma ro gcig sa bcu'i rtogs pa shar// dus gsum rgyal ba'i sras po gzhan don mdzad// rtse mo thob nas 'phel ba rgyun mi 'chad// bzhi pa rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis// bsgom du med pa'i nyams len brtson pa las// mkhyen pa'i ye shes sangs rgyas zhing khams mthong*// ma btsal lhun grub chos mchog chen po'i ngang*/ zhes gsungs pa ste/ ting 'dzin 'di gsum la/ ting 'dzin gyi sgo thams cad 'du zhing*/ de gsum yang rdo rje lta bu la 'dus pa dang*/ de ni mngon du gyur ma gyur gyi khyad tsam las/ sa bcu'i rgyun mtha'i de dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi mkhyen pa gnyis ldan gyi ye shes de dang*/

da lta'i tha mal shes pa bzo med du 'jog pa 405)'di dang gsum po ngo bo khyad med tshul ni/ gong du mi la'i gsung des go mod la/ nyid kyis/ 'di shes rab kyi smon lam du dgos mdog kha yang*/ bsam gtan du byung gsungs pa ni/ shes rab kyi don de rtogs pa'i thabs ni bsam gtan yin pa la dgongs par go'o/ yang zung 'jug yan lag bdun ldan zhes pa'i 'dren tshul gang yin gsungs pa 'di ni gsar ma rang la grags che bas dgongs par los bzhugs mod kyis/ 'di la 'bras bu'i yan lag bdun dang*/ rgyu'i yan lag bdun te gnyis yod pa las/ 'bras bu'i bdun ni/ 'og min gyi gnas su dag pa'i 'khor 'ba' shig la zab gsal gyi chos 'khor la rtag tu longs spyod pas na/ longs spyod kyi lan yag mtshan rdzogs longs sku rang 'od kyi yum dang 'du 'bral med pa/ kha sbyor gyi yan lag zag med ye shes kyi bde ba rgyun chad med pas/ bde chen gyi yan lag dmigs 406)med thugs rje mkha' ltar khyab pas/ snying rjes gang ba'i yan lag phrin las 'khor ba'i mtha' mnyam du 'byung bas/ rgyun mi 'chad pa'i yan lag zhi ba'i mtha' la mi gnas pas/ 'gog pa med pa'i yan lag stong nyid snying rje zung 'jug gi rang bzhin spros pa'i mtha' las 'das pa ni rang bzhin med pa'i yan lag de ltar sku gsum dbyer med kyi che ba'i yon tan bdun du 'dren la/ gnyis pa 'bras bu de lta bu 'grub byed rgyu'i yan lag bdun ni/ zung 'jug gi lam nyams su blang bya'i don gyi ye shes de nyid la yod med rtag chad gnyis 'dzin gyi mtshan ma'i mtha' dang bral bas rang bzhin med pa'i yan lag dang*/ phyi nang bdag gzhan thabs shes dbyings dang ye shes sogs gnyis chos thams cad zung 'jug tu gdod nas lhun gyis grub par shes pa ni kha sbyor gyi yan lag bde sdug tsha grang sogs su btags pa'i tshor ba thams cad lhan skyes bde chen gyi ngo bor rtogs pa ni bde ba chen po'i yan lag

407)'dod yon lnga sogs yul dang dngos por snang ba bzang ngan thams cad ro mnyam bdud rtsi'i chen por longs spyod pa ni longs spyod kyi yan lag de ltar ma rtogs pa'i 'gro la ris med phan pa bsgrub par go cha bgo ba ni snying rjes gang ba'i yan lag de lta bu'i brtson pa rgyun mi 'chad par rim gnyis kyi nyams len zab mo gzhan don du 'bad pa ni rgyun chad med pa'i yan lag de lta bu la khengs rloms dang bdag lta sogs kyi dri mas ma gos par 'khor gsum yongs dag chen por spyod pa ni 'gog pa med pa'i yan lag ste/ de ltar bdun ldan la brten pas/ 'bras bu'i yan lag bdun po gegs med du 'grub par gsungs so/ de yang rdo rje theg pa nyams su len pa'i rten gzhi so sor thar pa'i sdom pa nges par dgos mi dgos kyi dri ba dang*/ zhar la jo bo'i lam sgron gyi lung*/ so so thar pa rigs bdun gyi/ zhes sogs kyi dgongs 408)pa ltar byang sdom gyi rten du so thar dgos mi dgos sogs gsungs pa'i char/ spyir ni rgyal ba'i bstan pa'i gzhi ma 'dul ba yin pa dang*/ de'i bslab pa thams cad kyi rtsa ba ni/ nyes spyod sdom pa/ dge ba chos sdud pa/ sems can don byed dang gsum du 'du la/ de gsum ni byang sdom dang sngags sdom gnyis ka'i don gyi rtsa ba yin phyir dang*/ so thar ni gzhan la gnod pa spong ba/ byang sdom ni phan pa bsgrub pa/ sngags su ni dag snang lam 'khyer yin phyir gnod pa ma spangs par gzhan gnyis nam yang mi 'grub pa dang*/ gzhan yang*/ sngags lam nyams su len pa'i rten ni rab dge slong*/ 'bring dge tshul/ tha ma khyim pa dge bsnyen du gsungs pa dang*/ yang*/ sa thob ma gtogs khyim pa yis// bla ma'i ming du mi bya'o/ zhes pas ye shes kyi rgan pa yin na ma gtogs sngags kyi sdom ldan khyim pa'i cha byad ni rab 409)byung gi gral gong dang phyag dang bsnyen bkur sogs spang dgos tshul dang*/

ma spangs na rgyal ba'i bstan pa dang dkon mchog gsum la brnyas par 'gyur tshul sogs du ma 'byung phyir/ des na sngags kyi sdom pa'i rten du 'og ma rnams tshang bar yod na gsum ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa zhes mchog tu gyur par gsungs mod la/ byang sdom gyi rten du yang so thar yod na mchog tu legs shing*/ dbu sems gnyis kyi bzhed pa dang mthun par 'gyur mod kyi/ 'on kyang gong gi lam sgron gyi lung de ni byams mgon thogs med sku mched las brgyud pa'i sems tsam gyi bzhed pa yin la/ 'jam dbyangs klu sgrub yab sras nas brgyud pa dbu ma'i lugs la ni/ skyabs sdom la rten pas kyang rung ba dang*/ lha la sogs pa yang byang sdom gyi gang zag snod rung du gsungs pa ltar lags mod/ dmigs bsal gyi skabs don la/ sngags kyi rten du 410)so thar gyi rab byung kho na nges par dgos pa ni ma lags te/ rgya gar du in+d+ra bho dhi dang rgyal po dzaḥdang rab gsal zla ba sogs mtha' yas pa dang*/ dus 'khor chos rgyal rigs ldan thams cad dang*/ bod yul du mes dbon rnam gsum sogs dang*/ gzhan yang mar mi yab sras rnams dang*/ sa skya'i dkar po rnam gsum sogs dang*/ rnying ma'i grub thob phal cher dang*/ g.yu thog mgon po sogs mdor na khyim pa'i tshul gyi sngags kyi grub thob ni bsam gyis mi khyab pas/ o rgyan gyi lung bstan dag las kyang*/ grangs kyi bstan pa ste ban rgyas na yang*// grub thob rtogs ldan sngags pa sgom chen mang*/ zhes dang*/ dge 'dun gyi sde tshogs grangs mang por 'byung yang*/ grub pa brnyes pa ni/ sngags 'chang dang sgom chen rnams las mang bar gsungs shing*/ ci 'o na so thar sngags kyi gzhi rten yin na/ rab byung ma yin pa de dag ci'i phyir sngags 'grub ce na/ de dag 411)ltar snang du 'dul ba kho na'i rtags dang cho ga ma blangs pa tsam ma gtogs/ don gyi sdom pa gsum ldan yang dag pa yin te/

dbang gi skabs su/ tshul khrims kyis ni bslab pa dang*/ ces sogs mtha' dag thob pa'i phyir te/ sgyu 'phrul drwa ba las/ bla med mchog gi sdom pa ru// 'dul ba'i dbang gi sdom pa dang*// byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa sogs// ma lus kun 'dus rnam par dag ces gsungs pa ltar yin la/ 'o na jo bo rje dang*/ 'jig rten gsum mgon dang*/ gtsang pa rgya ras sogs skyes chen mang po sngags kyi grub pa brnyes nas kyang slar bsnyen par rdzogs tshul bstan pa ci yin snyam na/ de dag ni rang don mngon du gyur kyang gdul bya thun mong mang po theg pa rim 'jug gi lam la khrid nas bstan pa'i bya ba rgya cher bsgrub pa'i slad du bla ma dang lha yi lung bstan pa la brten nas de ltar mdzad pa yin gyis/ gsang sngags kyi 412)chos sgo ma chod par so thar la 'jug pa ni ma yin no/ yang so thar gyi sdom pa bsrung ma nus pas gsang sngags pa yin par rloms pa'i rtsing spyod pa rnams ni mdo sngags gnyis kar mi rung ste/ sngags gsar ma'i dam tshig gi skabs kyi brtul zhugs nyer lnga'i thog ma ni rtsa bzhi chang dang lnga yin phyir dang*/ rnying ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig nyer bdun gyi nang tshan yang de dag yin phyir/ bye brag gzhan rnams phar zhog rtsa ba bzhi po ma bsrung ba de ni 'dul ba tsam du ma zad sngags kyi dam nyams su 'gyur ba nyid de/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ tshul khrims 'chal pas sngags 'grub par// rgyal ba rnams kyis ma gsungs te// mya ngan 'das 'gror 'gyur ba yi// yul dang phyogs mtshams ma yin no/ zhes gsungs shing*/ yang de ltar dbang gsum pa sogs sbyor sgrol gyi lam rnams ci yin zhe na/ gsang sngags pa spyi la ni de rnams sgra ji bzhin ma yin pa'i tshig tu gsungs 413)pa yin te/ dgongs pa lung ston gyi rgyud las/ ma byin len ni byang chub sems// kun rdzob ston la rdzun du brjod// phung po srog chags gsod pa'i tshig

/tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi bud med ces// dgongs pa yis ni bshad pa la// byis pa rnams kyi yi ger 'khrul// rdo rje theg par gnas 'dod kyang*// chos nyid de yis mi shes so/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ de yang gang zag khyad par ba yul dang yul can tha dad du 'dzin pa'i blo dang zhen pa zad de rtogs pa mngon du gyur pa dag la ni sgra ji bzhin par spyad du rung ba ste/ ye shes rgyas pa'i rgyud las/ ji ltar sgyu ma'i mkhan po dag /rang gis sprul pa'i sgyu ma la// dge dang mi dge'i 'dus byas kyang*// nyes pa gang gis mi gos ltar// thabs la mkhas pas de bzhin spyad/ ces gsungs shing*/ 'di lta bu yang mdo sngags gnyis ka dgongs pa mthun te/ ting 'dzin rgyal po'i mdor/ ngo bo nyid 414)stong rang bzhin 'od gsal ba// bdag med chos rnams de yis rnam rig na// de la nam yang sdom pa med mi 'gyur/ zhes dang*/ 'dul ba nyid nas kyang ji skad du/ rab tu byung ba de lta bu la ni ka ṣa pā ṇi stong ri ba'i gos dang*/ mi lnga brgya shong ba'i tsan+dan gyi khang brtsegs dang*/ ro brgya dang ldan pa'i zas rnams kyang rjes su gnang ngo*/ zhes dang*/ gzhan yang*/ rgyan gyis brgyan par byas kyang chos spyod cing*/ sogs nas/ dge slong dge sbyong de yin bram ze'ang de/ zhes sogs kyis go mod kyang*/ de lta bu'i nus ldan ni ding sang dkon par zad do/ de'i phyir na/ rang rang gi rgyud tshod dam/ nus pa dang mthun pa'i spyod pa gal che ba dang*/ de ltar shes na gong gi dam sdom kun kyang rang rgyud la yongs rdzogs su 'byung ba lags/ yang so thar gyi sdom pa 'di za ma dang ma ning lha dang gsum la mi skye ba'i rgyu gang yin pa dang*/ brgya byin ni sa gsum pa'i byang sems su gsungs na/ sdom pa mi skye ba'i lha 115)de gang yin pa sogs dri ba gnang ba la/ de yang sdom pa'i rtsa ba'i gnad don ni/ mdo sngags dgongs pa gcig pa yin phyir/
