'dul ba nas spang byar bshad pa'i nyes spyod rnams gsang sngags nas thabs kyis ma zin par rang gar spyad chog pa ni nam du yang ma gsungs phyir/ mi tshangs spyod sdom gyi dbang du bgyi na/ 'dul ba ni chags yul dang chags spyod spong ba yin la/ gsang sngags su spyod kyang chags pa'i dri mas ma gos par bya ba yin tshe/ de gnyis ka tha mal rang ga'i chags pa'i skyon gyis ma gos par mtshungs pa ste/ des na 'dul ba'i skabs su chags spyod kyi nus pa yod bzhin mi spyod pa de la tshangs par spyod pa zhes bya la/ spyod pa'i nus pa med na spong ba dang bsrung ba'i phan yon 'ong don med pa la dgongs nas/ ma ning sogs la snod min du gsungs shing*/ ma ning la dbye na rigs bcu bzhir bgrangs mod kyang 116)bsdu na pho mo'i dbang po don byed nus pa dang mi ldan pa la 'jug cing*/ za ma ni spyir ma ning bcu bzhi'i nang mtshan du 'du yang*/ dmigs bsal du/ pho'i 'bras bu bcad pa la 'jug pa ste/ rgya gar rgya nag sogs su btsun mo bsrung mkhan dang*/ g.yog rnams la 'bras bu phyungs nas de la nyug rum pa zhes 'bod pa lta bu za ma zhes bya ba dang*/ de'i zhar la/ dge tshul la lo bdun dang*/ bsnyen rdzogs su nyi shu lon dgos pa dang*/ bar chad dri ba'i tshe yang*/ lo bco lnga ma lon pa ma yin nam/ lo bco lnga lon pa bya rog skrod mi nus pa ma yin nam/ zhes pa yang*/ chags spyod kyi nus pa rdzogs ma rdzogs la dgongs par gsungs so/ lha dang sgra mi snyan dang*/ mi ma yin rnams la sdom pa mi skye ba ni/ so thar ni nges 'byung la brten dgos kyi/ lha dang sgra mi snyan sogs gnas skabs su rang gi bsod nams kyi longs spyod dang tshe sogs 417)'byor pa rgya che bas nges 'byung gi blo mi skye ba dang*/ nyon mongs rags pa mngon gyur kyang cher med pas sdom par bya ba'i rgyu ma tshang ba yin la/ tshangs pa dang brgya byin sogs thub pa'i zhabs pad la bsten zhing byang chub sems dpa' yin na'ang so thar gyi dge slong ma yin no/

de nas yang*/ gnas brtan bcu drug gi lo rgyus skor gyi zhib cha'i dri ba gnang ba'i char/ bdag gis gnas bcu'i cho ga dang rjes gnang gi rigs sogs rnying lugs dang*/ bka' gdams lugs sogs 'ga' zhig thob na'ang*/ lo rgyus kyi rigs ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi rtogs brjod las byung ba ltar/ nyid kyi gsungs pa de las zhib pa gcig ma mthong zhing*/ de ka'i lugs nas gnas brtan rnams kyi mtshan dang bzhugs gnas dang dgra bcom gyi grangs sogs deng sang gi yongs grags dang cung zad mi 'dra ba byung la/ slob dpon rin po che'i gsung las byung ba'i gter chos kyi gzhung rnams dang*/ 418)ding sang chos rgyud thams cad kyi tshogs 'dun du byed pa/ paṇa chen shākya shrīs mdzad pa'i gnas brtan phyag 'tshal ni mthun par snang ngo*/ des na skabs don 'bul rgyur/ gnas brtan bcu drug rgya dkar nag lugs gnyis su bshad pa de ni ngo bo mi gcig pa gnyis ni ma lags mod kyang*/ ding sang sku 'dra la na bza'i khyad kyis phye ba ste/ rab byung cha byad gtsang mar yod pa de rgya gar lugs dang*/ zab ber ram phod ka sogs lhab lhub sna tshogs yod pa de la rgya nag lugs su grags par snang la/ de ni rgya nag gi rgyal po tha hi dzus dang por birba pa sogs grub thob mang po spyan drangs nas mchod pa byas/ de nas gnas brtan bcu drug spyan drangs nas mchod cing*/ na bza'i khyad par mang po phul ba'i skabs kyi ding phon sogs yod par dpyad don mkhan rnams 'chad la/ nyid kyi bka' phebs ltar/ hwa shang zhes pa ni spyir rgya nag gi rab byung bsam gtan pa thams cad la hwa shang du 'bod par 419)snang la/ gnas brtan rnams kyi sbyin bdag 'di la yang hwa shang zer ba/ dang por khyim pa yin zhing 'byor pa shin tu che yang*/ bu med pa'i sdug bsngal la brten nas gnas brtan rnams khyim du gdan drangs te rgya cher mchod cing gsol ba btab pas bu bcu drug byung*/

phyis kho rang rab tu byung bas hwa shang zhes grags pa yin par thos la/ dharma tā ni 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs nyid shākya'i bstan pa skyong phyir dge bsnyen du sprul te gnas brtan rnams kyi zhabs 'bring ba'i tshul gyis 'gro don mdzad pa ste/ de nyid bod yul du yang 'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas sogs su sprul te bstan pa'i bya ba mdzad par o rgyan gyi lung bstan mang por gda' 'o/ des na gnas bcu rgya nag lugs zhes zer ba'i rgyu mtshan ni de tsam du zad la/ spyir gnas brtan zhes pa ni dge 'dun rnams kyi gtso bo ste/ 420)ding sang gi chos sde'i slob dpon lta bu yin par snang zhing*/ bcu drug po 'di dag ni shākya'i dbang po 'di kho na'i sprul pa'i nyan thos kyis tshul gyis/ ji srid shākya'i bstan pa'i mtha' ma rdzogs kyi ring la mya ngan las 'da' ba med par bzhugs nas/ sku gsung thugs rten dang gtsug lag khang dang gaṇ+ḍi sogs kyi rab gnas tshul ldan gang du byed pa'i sa dang*/ gzhan yang dge 'dun gyi 'du tshogs sam/ dad ldan gang gis sar mchod pa bshams shing gus pas spyan drangs na/ rdzu 'phrul gyis 'byon par 'gyur ba ni gong gi hwa shang gi dpes go ba ltar dang*/ sngon ma gha dha bzang mos grong khyer bu ram shing 'phel nas dad pa'i shugs dang spos kyi mchod pas ston pa 'khor bcas spyan drangs pa'i spos dud kyis rgyal byed tshal gyi nam mkha' la spos kyi sprin chags shing*/ dpag tshad lnga bcu'i sa der skad cig la byon nas yul khams de dag 421)smin par mdzad pa lta bu lags shing*/ ston pa 'di kho na ma gtogs sangs rgyas gzhan la ni gnas brtan bcu drug gi tha snyad ni med pa dang*/ yang nyid kyi/ 'di dag la gnas brtan gyis mtshan yong lugs kyis/ grub mtha'ang gnas brtan sde pa yin nam gsungs pa de ni ma lags te/ gnas brtan gyi mtshan tsam ni mang ste/ gnas brtan 'od srungs/

gnas brtan rab 'byor/ zhes sogs thams cad la 'bod cing*/ grub mtha' sde pa bzhi dang*/ de las gyes pa bco brgyad sogs ni bka' bsdu gnyis pa phyin chad la byung ba ma gtogs/ ston pa bzhugs dus su tha dad med mod kyi/ lar grub mtha' gyes tshul la'ang*/ la la'i bzhed kyis/ thog mar phal chen dang gnas brtan pa gnyis su byung*/ de las kyang gsum dang bzhi sogs gyes par bshad la/ bka' brgyud 'di yi lugs la ni dang po nas bzhir gyes par bzhed do/ phyi 422)rol pa rnams kyi/ 'jig rten gyi mi rigs bzhi po tshangs pa'i gdong pa bzhi las so sor byung bar 'dod pa dang sgo btun nas/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i zhal bzhi las sde pa bzhi byung bar gsungs pa dang*/ nang gi rtsa 'khor bzhi yi spyi gtsug ni khams byang chub kyi sems phal cher 'du phyir/ phal chen pa'i sde dang*/ mgrin pa ni zas skom gyis bkur nas yin phyir/ mang bkur sde dang*/ snying ga ni dran bsam thams cad kyi 'byung gnas yin phyir thams cad yod smra dang*/ lte ba ni chags pa'i snga shos yin tshe/ rgan po'am gnas brtan pa'i sder ming gi gsungs pa sogs ni gsang sngags kyi sgra ji bzhin ma yin pa'i brda'i bye brag 'di lta bu ni bsam gyi mi khyab mod/ sde pa bzhi'i mkhan po'i byung khungs kyang*/ bka' brgyud kyi bzhed par/ sgra gcan 'dzin las mang bkur dang*/ 'od bsrungs las gnas brtan dang*/ ka t+yā ya na las phal chen pa dang*/ nye bar 'khor las yod smra rnams byung tshul gyi 423)lugs 'di ni/ dbyig bshes kyis mdzad pa'i rig pa klog pa'i 'khor lo'am/ sde pa tha dad bklag pa'i 'khor lo zhes pa'i gzhung de'i dgongs par bzhed la/ kun mkhyen klong chen pa sogs kyis bzhed tshul/ slob dpon pad+mas mdzad pa'i dge slong dang dge tshul gyi lo dri ba zhes pa de'i lugs yin par gsungs shing*/ lugs 'di la ni/ sgra gcan 'dzin yod smra/ 'od srungs phal chen pa/

ka t+yā gnas brtan pa/ nye bar 'khor mang bkur du bshad de/ rang nyid kyi go tshul ni/ phyogs zhen ma yin te/ bod 'dir 'dul ba'i sdom rgyun snga phyi thams cad yod smra'i lugs 'ba' shig la/ 'di'i mkhan rgyud ni sgra gcan 'dzin nas brgyud lugs la dpags na/ sde pa bzhi'i ngos 'dzin lugs kyang slob dpon pad+ma'i bzhed pa 'di bden nam bsam pa blun tshod lags/ gzhan yang jo bo rje ni phal chen pa yin pas/ jo bo bod du phebs skabs su dang por ni/ 424)khyod bod yul 'dir yod smra'i sde gcig pu las mi 'dug pas/ phal chen pa'i mkhan po nga rang gi bya/ gzhan gnyis po'i mkhan po rgya gar nas gdan drangs te/ bod 'dir sde pa bzhi ka tshang bar 'dzugs dgos gsungs pa la/ phyis bod kyi btsun pa rnams chang 'thung ba gzigs pas shin tu thugs khrel nas/ de phyin chad su la yang sdom pa ma gnang bas/ bod 'dir thams cad yod smra las gzhan pa'i sde ma byung ba dang*/ gzhan yang lo rgyus 'ga' zhig tu/ phal chen pa'i sde pa rnams chos gos rnam gsum dkar por byed phyir/ jo bo yang dang po na bza' dkar por yod kyang*/ bod la gos dkar can la rab byung du mi rtsi ba gsan pas/ mang yul du phebs nas na bza' ngur smrig tu bsgyur ba yin par grags kyang*/ de ni mi bden par mngon te/ jo bo'i rnam thar nyid du/ gser gling du phebs dus dpon slob brgya dang nyi shu 425)rtsa lnga'i rnam sbyar ngur smig gi 'od kyi bar snang thams cad thun mtshams kyi 'od ltar gyur tshul sogs kyis go mod cing sde pa bzhi rnams rnam sbyar gyi rtags tha dad du bshad pa ma gtogs kha dog tha dad du ma bshad pa'i phyir ro/ yang gong gi 'phror/ nyid kyis/ tshe lo bcu pa nas shākya'i bstan pa rdzogs pa yin par bshad pa dang*/ slar yar 'phel gyi bdun brgya pa la gnas brtan bcu drug rnams bstan pa'i bya ba mdzad tshul bshad pa gnyis 'gal bas the tshom byung gsungs pa la/

shākya'i bstan pa dngos kyi gnas tshad ni tshe lo bcu par rdzogs tshul yig cha kun mtshungs mod kyi/ 'on kyang*/ lo grangs ma mthun pa du ma ni mdo sde rnams las gsungs pa dang*/ rjes 'brang gi bstan bcos rnams nas kyang sna tshogs 'byung ba ste/ 'dul ba lung phran tshegs nas/ shākya'i bstan pa mi lo bdun stong gnas rgyu la/ skye dgu'i bdag 426)mo rab tu byung pa'i rkyen gyi nyis stong mar bri ste/ lnga stong gnas par gsungs pa dang*/ mdo bskal bzang las/ bstan pa dngos lo lnga brgya/ gzugs brnyan tsam lnga brgya ste lo stong gnas par gsungs pa dang*/ snying rje pad+ma dkar po las phyed dang nyis stong dang*/ zla ba snying po'i mdo nyis stong dang*/ blo gros mi zad pa'i mdo'i 'grel par yang stong dang*/ rdor gcod 'grel par byed dang gsum stong dang*/ 'bum ṭig gnod 'joms las lnga stong du gsungs pa las/ ding sang ni phyi ma 'di kho na'i lugs la cha 'jog pa mang ba dang*/ lugs 'di la lo lnga brgya phrag bcur byed pa'i dang po gsum la/ dgra bcom pa/ phyir mi 'ong*/ rgyun du zhugs pa ste/ 'bras bu'i dus gsum brjod la/ de nas bar pa gsum la/ lhag mthong dang*/ ting 'dzin dang*/ tshul khrims te/ sgrub pa'i dus gsum dang*/ de nas phyi ma gsum la/ mngon pa dang*/ mdo sde dang*/ 'dul ba 427)ste/ lung gi dus gsum dang*/ mthar rtags tsam 'dzin gyi dus gcig dang bcas pa rnams yod pa las/ ding sang ni gzhan rnams rdzogs nas/ mdo sde'i dus kyi lhag ma lo nyis brgya tsam dang*/ 'dul ba'i lnga brgya dang*/ rtags tsam 'dzin gyi lnga brgya rnams yod par gsung mkhan mang bar gda' na'ang*/ de la yang ston pa'i 'khrungs lo nas bzung ste/ 'dren mi 'dren gyi tshul dang 'khrungs lo'i 'dod tshul lugs mi mthun pa mang bas mtha' gcig tu 'dzin dka' zhing*/ dus 'khor gyi bstan rtsis mkhan po rnams kyang bzhed pa mi gcig par snang bas/

bdag ni dkar rtsis sogs dang por bslab pa'i khul gyi 'go gtsugs nas slar/ sgom phyogs la 'bad lo dang 'di rnams rgyab 'gal du go ba nas rgyang du bskyur bas mi shes la/ nyid dkar rtsis sogs los mkhyen te/ bstan rtsis kyi rnam gzhag sogs dgongs par 428)bzhugs mchi/ gzhan yang*/ byams pa lung bstan gyi mdor/ shā ri'i bus/ nga yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas lo stong phrag lnga'i bar la rnam pa lnga po 'di dag rim gyis nub par 'gyur ro/ lnga gang zhe na/ dang po la 'bras bu thob pa rnams nub par 'gyur ba dang*/ de nas sgrub pa la gnas pa rnams nub par 'gyur ba dang*/ de nas lung gi chos rnams nub par 'gyur ba dang*/ de nas ngur smrig gi rtags rnams nub par 'gyur ba dang*/ de nas thub pa'i ring bsres rnams nub par 'gyur ba yin no/ zhes gsungs pa 'di yang 'bum ṭī ga'ang mthun mod kyi/ de yang bstan pa dngos ni lo lnga stong nas rdzogs par gsal zhing*/ slar yar 'phel gyi drug brgya nas bdun brgya'i bar du gnas brtan rnams kyis kyang gdul bya'i lhag ma rnams la rang rang gi skal ba dang 'tshams pa'i 'gro don mdzad par go la/ de'i mthar de bzhin gshegs pa'i bka' dang*/ ring bsrel sogs lha klu mi'i gnas thams cad 429)nas gang bzhugs kun bsdus te byang chub kyi snying po rdo rje gdan du rin chen gyi mchod rten du bzhugs su gsol nas phyag mchod mdzad de gnas brtan rnams kyang lhag med kyi dbyings su mya ngan las 'das shing*/ mchod rten de yang rim gyis dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi la thug par nub nas mi snang bar 'gyur la/ nam sems can rnams nad dang mtshon dang mu ge'i bskal pa sogs kyi mnar ba'i tshe/ slar yang ring bsrel de dag nor bu rin po che bai ḍūr+ya tog gi blo gros zhes bya ba'i rang bzhin du gyur nas/ skye 'gro gang gis mthong thos reg pa tsam gyis sdug bsngal de dag las skyob pa dang*/

rin po che de rnams nam mkhar 'phags te 'og min gyi gnas la thug gi bar gyi 'gro ba rnams la me tog dang rin chen gyi char 'bebs/ chos kyi sgra sgrog pa sogs kyi gzhan phan mtha' yas mdzad tshul byams pa lung bstan dang snying rje pad+ma dkar po sogs mdo sde rnams las gsungs 430)phyir sangs rgyas kyi phrin las ni mtha' gtug pa ma mchis mod kyi/ gong gi bstan pa'i rdzogs tshad sogs 'di dag ni gdul bya thun mong pa'i snang ngor sde snod gsum gyi bstan pa kho na'i dbang du mdzad mod la/ thun mong ma yin pa rdo rje theg pa'i nges don gyis dbang ltar na ni/ sangs rgyas mya ngan yongs mi 'da'// chos kyang nub par mi 'gyur te/ zhes pa ltar/ ji srid sems can kyi khams nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam de srid sangs rgyas kyi phrin las mtshungs par 'byung ba nyid do/ 'di'i phros zhor du/ rab byung gi yo byad chos gos rnam gsum gding lhung chab ril sogs kyi dgos pa dang chag tshad/ dbye ba/ yang gos lham sbubs can gyi rigs spang dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan sogs 'dul ba'i skabs kyi dri ba zhib rgyas gnang ba'ang*/ spyir deng sang gi rnying ma dang*/ khyad par bdag cag mtha' khob dwags kong gi rnying hrul rnams la 'dul ba'i dri tsam snom ma myong bas ci 431)zhu ba las med kyang*/ phran tshegs tsam gyi go tshod snyan du 'bul rgyur/ de yang so sor thar pa'i sdom pa la gnas mkhan zhig byed phyin chad sbyangs yon bcu gnyis ni med thabs med par gsungs te/ gang zhe na/ zas nyin gcig 'tsho ba'i bsod snyoms dang*/ nyin re la mang po mi za ba stan cig pa dang*/ chog shes bzhin slar yang 'dod pa mi byed pas phyis mi len pa ste/ de ltar zas kyi sbyangs yon gsum/ gos gsar pa 'chor po sogs kyi zhen 'dod spong phyir phyag dar khrod pa dang*/ spu can dang 'jam po dang sbubs can sogs spong ba phying pa ba dang*/ gos theb lhag mang po mi 'dzin phyir chos gos gsum pa ste/

gos kyi sbyangs yon gsum/ gnas rnam g.yeng 'du long can sogs spong ba dgon pa dang*/ steng nas thog 'bub pa dang*/ mtha' bskor nas rtsigs pa dang*/ gyang dang lcags ri 432)sogs bshoms zhing btsan pa'i zhen pa spong bas/ bla gab med pa dang*/ shing drung pa dang*/ gnas skyid po la zhen chags bdag bzung spong phyir dur khrod pa ste/ de ltar gnas kyi sbyangs yon bzhi/ nyal ba kho na la zhen pa spong tsog bu pa dang*/ mal gdan sogs 'jam po dang dro 'jam bde ba sogs kyi rtsol zhen spong bas gzhi ji bzhin pa ste/ mal gdan gyi sbyangs yon gnyis rnams bsdom pa'i sbyangs yon bcu gnyis la rtag tu spyod par 'dul ba nas gsungs na'ang*/ deng sang gi dge sbyong rnams kyi spyod pa dang rgyab 'gal du gda' mod/ gos sbubs can zhes phu dung*/ dor ma/ lham yu ba can sogs ni khyim pa'i rtags yin phyir dang*/ de dang mtshungs par/ skra mi 'breg pa dang*/ rgyan gyis bye brag dang*/ rta la sogs pa'i gzhon pa'i rigs rnams dang*/ gri chung sor bzhi'am drug las lhag pa'i mtshon cha'i rigs dang*/ gzhan yang phyag 433)dar dang zhing las kyi yo byad sogs khyim pa'i rtags su gyur pa'i lag cha dang yo byad kyi rigs mtha' dag 'chang bar ma gnang ngo*/ 'chang du rung ba'i yo byad kyi gtso bo ni sdom pa'i las chog las byung ba'i/ chos gos rnam pa gsum ni/ rnam sbyar/ bla gos/ mthang gos dang gsum/ lhung bzed/ gding ba/ chu tshags dang bcas pa ni gtso bo yin par bshad cing*/ lhag pa'i yo byad bcu gsum du bgrang ba'i tshe na/ snam sbyar/ bla gos/ mthang gos/ sham thabs/ de'i gzan/ rngul gzan/ de'i gzan/ gding ba/ gdong phyis/ snag zan/ g.yan dgab/ skra bzed/ dbyar gyis ras chen te bcu gsum dang*/ khyad par ba ni sra kyang sogs dang*/ mkhar sil dang ril ba sogs zhar la phran tshegs kyi yo byad rnams gsungs mod kyang*/ gzhan rnams deng sang dar cha chung la/ gtso bor dge tshul la snam sbyar mi 'byung mod kyi gzhan

434)dge slong dang mtshungs pa ste/ chos gos rnam gsum gyi rgyur rung dang mi rung gi bye brag mang yang*/ bod du ni spu can dang rnga ther min pa'i rgyu la bya ba dang*/ kha dog ni/ rgya skeg leb rgan rtsi dang btsod/ rma shing rtsi dang mthing shun mtshal// sin+du+u ra dang gur kum ste// 'di dag tshon chen brgyad du grags/ ces pa rnams mi rung la/ rung ba'i tshon gsum ni/ sngon po btsag dang ngur smrig rtsi// 'di dag rung ba'i tshon gsum yin/ zhes pas sngo skya dang*/ btsag kha dang*/ chu rtsa'i mdog rnams bya bar gsungs mod cing*/ che chung gi tshad ni/ rnam sbyar dang bla gos gnyis la yas man du khru gsum phan tshun la khru lnga ste/ 'di ni che tshad yin zhing*/ chung tshad ni yas man phyed dang gsum/ phan tshun phyed lnga ste/ de ltar lus tshad che chung dang bstun nas 'tshams par bya zhing*/ mthang gos kyi tshad ni yas man du khru do'i phyed dang do/ phan tshun la khru lnga'am bzhir gsungs pa dang*/ gding ba'i dkyus 435)la khru gsum/ zheng du khru do sor drug tu gsungs mod kyi/ deng sang ni spyir yang chag tshad dang mi mthun pa 'ba' shig dang*/ khyad par mthang gos kyi dar cha chung bas sham thabs dkyus ma 'di la'ang tshad med chor mdzes kho nar byed pa zad do/ lhung bzed sogs yo byad gzhan rnams kyi tshad sogs ni brjod pa'i dgos pa deng sang mi snang la/ nyid kyi dri ba'i skabs don gyi snying por/ sde pa bzhi la bla gos mthang gos gding ba sogs mthun na'ang*/ snam sbyar gyi snam phran dang rtags kyi khyad par mi 'dra ba'i tshul/ nyid rang gi ji ltar gsungs pa de bzhin lags kyi/ de la snam phran dang glegs bu dang tshal bu sogs ngos 'dzin tshul dang 'dren tshul mi mthun pa mang yang*/ 'o bskol gyi lugs la ni snam sbyar chos gos gnyis rab byung la dras drub kho na dang*/ khyad par snam sbyar ni nges par dras drub bya bar 'dul ba nas gsungs kyang*/

deng sang ni 436)lhan thabs ma 'di kho na mang bar gda' bas/ 'di'i dbang du bgyis na/ yas man du ka ba lta bur yod pa 'di ni snam phran yin la phan tshun du gdang bu lta bu la glegs bu zhes bya ba yin pa dang*/ 'di gnyis kyi tshem bu'i che chung ni tshad gi sor bzhi/ gsum gnyis kyi bar gang 'tshams bya bar bshad/ mtha' ljags la ni tshal bu las sor gnyis kyi che bar byed do/ snam phran gyi grangs 'dren pa ni/ ka ba re dang de'i bar gyi sa stong re bsdoms pa la snam phran re rtsis la/ rgyab gzhung gi snam phran de la ni ka ba gnyis g.yas g.yon so sor kha bstan zhing*/ gzhan rnams de dang 'gros mthun par g.yas g.yon la char khebs sam mu gnon gyi tshul du 'gro ba'i snam phran ji tsam yod pa'i steng du rgyab gzhung gi rnam phran de dang bsdoms pas/ bdun nam dgu nas nyer lnga'i bar gyi rgyas bsdus rnams 'byung la/ 437)yan man gyis glegs bu ni snam sbyar bsdus pa dang bla gos gnyis ka mthun par/ ka ba gnyis re'i bar du glegs bu phyed dang gsum yod do/ des na snam phran gyi grangs 'di snam sbyar nyid la rgyas bsdus rim pa mi gcig kyang*/ bla gos la ni snam phran bdun kho na yin pas/ 'di go na snam sbyar la go bar 'gyur ro/ mthang gos la snam phran lnga dang*/ glegs bu phyed dang gnyis gnyis/ gding ba ni glegs bu gcig pa zer yang*/ don la phyed dang gnyis par 'gyur ba nyid lags so/ chos gos zhes pa ni gsum ga'i spyi ming yin la/ 'di rnams kyi dgos ched ni/ khyim pa dang mu stegs sogs las khyad par du 'byed pa'i dkon mchog gi rtags yin phyir/ lha klu gnod sbyin dri za la sogs mi dang mi ma yin pa kun gyi phyag mchod bkur bsti'i gnas 438)su 'gyur ba dang*/ rang nyid kyang dge sbyor gyi 'du shes dang mi 'bral ba'i dgos pa yod par gsungs so/ chab ril ni/ gun+de'am ril ba spyi blugs zhes dbyibs las ming du btags pa 'di ni rgya gar bram ze drang srong sogs kun gyi thogs la/

gha ṭu zhes grags pa'i kha chod can bum pa 'dra min lta bu 'di la bya ma bum zhes bya ste/ chu len pa sogs gnas skabs kyi nyer mkho tsam yin tshe/ rab byung gi chab ril dngos ni rgyan drug ma 'di yin zer ba dang*/ rgyan drug ni phar phyin drug mtshon byed yin zer ba sogs ngag rgyun la snang na'ang yig cha la ma mthong zhing*/ rgyan drug po gang yin pa yang bshad tshul nges dag mi 'dug pa dang*/ de bzhin du lhung bzed shubs la rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi mtshon byed bshad mkhan sogs gda' ba'i khungs ni ma mthong tshe/ rig bzos sbyar na gang la sbyor sbyor 'ong mod kyang*/ gzhung gi khungs dgos par sems te/ mkhar 439)bsil la ni tshad dang dag sbyor sogs shin tu zhib par mdo nyid nas 'byung ba lags pa dang*/ chab len pa'i dgos pa'i gtso bo ni dge sbyong gi dran pa mi nyams pa'i rjed tho lta bu yin par gsungs la/ zhor byung du kha zas kyi ro la zhen pa gcod pa dang*/ kha'i dri ma ngan pas rang gi khong na lhan skyes kyi srin bu 'ga' zhig la gnod par 'gyur ba yod pas/ de las skyobs phyir dang kha'i dri ngan des dkon mchog gi rten dang dge 'dun sogs la nyes pa mi gsog pa'i slad du chab len par gsungs so/ stan la 'dug pa dang zas za ba sogs kyi dus su lham 'bud pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ ston pa bzhugs skabs su dge slong 'ga' zhig lham la mi gtsang ljan ljin sogs kyis gos pa stan la 'dug pas/ de mthong ba'i dge 'dun gzhan mang po zas mi 'dod par 'gyur zhing*/ stan yang mi rung par gyur pa la 440)ston pas da phyin chad mchil lham gyon bzhin stan la 'dug par mi byed ces bca' ba mdzad pa ste/ 'di la dpags na/ lham ma gyon kyang rkang pa 'phyi ba sogs ma byas par dge 'dun gyi stan la 'dug na nyes pa 'di 'byung nyes gda' bar go'o// gzhan yang nyid kyi phebs sgo ltar/ stod 'gag 'di rgya gar gyi rab byung la ni med de/

sdom pa'i cho gar bla gos sbyin pa'i tshig gi dang por/ 'di ni stod du gyon par bya ba'i chos gos bla gos zhes bya ba yin te/ stod gcer ba/ rlung dang nyi ma dang sbrang bu la sogs tsha grang gi reg pa las skyobs/ ces sogs 'byung phyir/ stod gos gzhan yong don med la/ 'on kyang dge slong ma rnams la nu ma sogs sgrib phyir shing nga dpung bcad du grags pa zhig yod par gda' zhing*/ bod 'dir sa grang ba'i gshis kyi jo bo rjes rtsar shag ces pa zhig sku la bzhes pas/ de nas 441)bzung ste bka' gdams pa'i stod 'gag hwa zlum de dar zhing*/ slad du paṇa chen shākya shrī yang sku bsil ba'i tshul bstan te/ bzhugs gding sku stod du bzhes pa la brten nas/ jo gdan pa'i phrag yu mar grags pa de dar ba yin par thos la/ da lta'i stod 'gag 'di la yang phu dung med tshe sbubs can gyi ltung ba med dam snyam zhing*/ gos chen sogs kyi mchor rgyan du byed pa de ni nam yang rung bar mi sems so/ mdor na shākya'i bstan la zhugs phyin chad/ bslab pa'i gnas phra zhib mang po 'o skol bod 'dir yul dang dus dbang gis bka' mod la/ 'gag tu dril ba'i snying por/ sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing*/ dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad/ ces 'di dang*/ de yis rtsa ba dngos ni/ rang gi sems ni yongs su gdul/ zhes pa 'dir bstan pa thams cad kyi sdom pa'i snying po gcig tu 'du ba yin par snang bas 442)rang rgyud dul ba zhig byung na bslab gzhi phra mo rnams shugs la tshang bar gda' na'ang*/ deng sang ni chab len pa dang lham 'bud pa sogs yan lag phra mo rnams la brtson par byed kyang*/ rtsa ba'i ltung ba che shos rnams la rdul tsam yang mi 'dzem/ phyi dro'i kha zas spangs pa yin zer bur sbrang phye mar sogs kha la mi dal bar spyod pa dang*/ khyad par rab byung gis sha chang 'dzem pa'i srol med pa 'di lta bu dang*/ kha zas byin len bya ba'i don ni rku 'phrog sogs ma byin len pa spong ba'i don yin mod kyang*/

gzhan nor la thabs sna tshogs kyi sgo nas ma sbyin len pa 'ba' shig byed bzhin du/ rang gi kha zas rang gis g.yos nas za ran tshe byin len byed grogs gcig 'tshol du 'gro ba sogs nyams 443)mtshar ba'i spyod tshul mang po deng sang gi dus 'dir dar bas/ 'di lta na/ gong du brjod pa'i bstan pa'i gnas tshad kyi gzhung rnams su/ lnga brgya tha ma rtags tsam 'dzin gyi dus su chos kyi spyod pa gzhan gang yang med pa la ngur smrig gi tshal bu re mgul dang skra dang rna ba sogs la 'dogs par 'gyur bar bshad kyang*/ da lta'i chos pa rnams kyi spyod tshul la bltas na rtags tsam 'dzin pa 'di ka yin nam snyam pas yid skyo zhing*/ gzhan yang zla ba snying po'i mdo dang*/ dkon brtsegs sogs mang por/ snyigs dus kyi dge sbyong rnams chos bzhin mi spyod par/ zhing las dang*/ tshong khe dang*/ dmag dang*/ 'khrug rtsod dang*/ bud med sogs khyim pa'i bya ba dang*/ nor gyis rtsol sgrub gsog 'jog dang*/ sde ris gnyen srid kyi phyogs chad dang*/ gyal po dang sbyin bdag sogs kyi nye gnas dang pho nya byed cing*/ bza' btung*/ gos rgyan/ glu gar/ gzhon pa/ go mtshon la sogs kyi yid 444)rnam par g.yeng*/ log par g.yeng*/ shin tu rab tu g.yeng ste/ mi rung ba'i bya ba 'ba' zhig gi dbang du gyur tshe/ bstan pa la dga' ba'i dkar phyogs kyi lha rnams mya ngan du gyur nas ring du dor/ nag po'i phyogs rnams mthu dang stobs rgyas pas/ 'jig rten gyi khams su mi nad dang phyugs nad sna tshogs dang*/ sa g.yos/ ri nyil/ brag chad/ chu smyon dang rlung dmar ldang ba la sogs dang*/ sad ser/ than chen/ zhod log la sogs pas lo 'bras 'bru bcud mi smin/ dug sbrul gcan gzan/ 'byung po mi ma yin la sogs kyi 'tshe bas skye 'gro rnams nyams thag par 'gyur tshul sogs ji ltar lung bstan pa thams cad rjes dpag ma yin par mngon sum tshad mar gyur pa 'di lags na'ang*/

da dung tshe 'di kho na'i bya ba dang*/ log pa'i 'tsho ba lnga bsgrub phyir kho na nyid la 'bad mkhan sha stag ste/ log 'tsho lnga gang zhe na/ tshul 'chos dang*/ kha gsag dang*/ gzhogs slong dang*/ thob kyis 445)'jal dang*/ brnyed pas rnyed pa 'tshol ba dang lnga yin te/ de las tshul 'chos ni/ rang gi sems rgyud gting nas ma rung bzhin du gzhan bslu ba'i phyir/ ma dul ba'i dul tshul/ mi shes pa'i shes brdzu/ ma grol ba'i grol brdzu sogs kyis gzhan bslus te rang 'dod bsgrub pa dang*/ kha gsag ni/ bdag dge ba'i rtsa ba rgya chen po de dang de lta bu byed pa yin pas khyed rnams kyis kyang ci 'byor pa phul zhig ces sogs brdzun dang g.yo rgyu'i bsam pa khong du bcangs nas/ dge bskul du bsnyad pas zang zing bsdu ba dang*/ gzhogs slong yang de dang cha 'dra ba ste/ sngon kun dga' ra ba'i btsun pa g.yo can zhig gis/ gtsug lag khang mjal mkhan gyi yon bdag pho mo mang po 'ong ba'i sar bsdad nas/ gding ba rtsid skus kyis btsem tshul byas pas/ khong rnams kyis skud pa de 'dras tshem du mi rung ngam zer ba la/ khos bdag 446)la bal skud ma 'dzoms pa yin byas pas/ 'o na bdag cag gi 'bul lo zer nas/ bal dang skud pa mang po byung ba'i lo rgyus kyi ngan g.yo de lta bu dang*/ thob kyis 'jal ba ni/ bdag gis khyed rnams kyi gshin po 'am gson po'i don 'di ltar byas pa yin pas/ yon dang 'bul ba sogs 'di dang 'di lta bu dgos so/ zhes sogs dang*/ khyod la gdams pa zab mo 'di lta bu byin dgos na khyod kyis kyang bdag la maṇ+ḍal gyi mchod pa 'di tsam zhig phul zhig ces sogs lta bu dang*/ brnyed pas brnyed 'tshol ni/ mi chos ngo bsrung thabs ka gnang sbyin sogs byas nas zang zing bsdud pa ste/ des na/ deng sang gi bla ma'am chos pa thams cad kyi bzhes sgo ni 'di rnams gang rung la ma brten pa zhig gar yang ma mthong bas/ yon mchod gnyis ka phyi ma'i 'bras bu ci 'drar 'gyur ba mi shes so/

gzhan yang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyi gsung las ni/ dge slong gnyis po 'dis dad pas byin pa'i zas za bar 447)gnang gis/ gzhan dag la ni cung zad tsam yang za bar mi gnang ngo*/ gnyis gang zhe na ldan pa dang grol ba'o/ zhes gsungs pa'i/ ldan pa ni tshul khrims ldan pa dang*/ grol ba ni sems rgyud grol bar yin par gsungs na/ da lta de gnyis ka yod mkhan dkon zhing*/ gzhan yang*/ dgra bcom mang pos dad zas kyi nyes dmigs la dgongs te/ dad zas mi 'byung ba'i ched kho na'i phyir du bslab pa 'bul bar zhus pas ston pas/ de de bzhin te shin tu legs so/ zhes gsungs pa'i tshul rgya cher gsungs phyir/ bdag sogs kyang dad zas zos pa la 'gyod cing*/ slan chad kyang de ltar za mkhan du mi skye bar smon pa'i rgyu mtshan de bzhin lags/ ces 'phros don du gsol ba'o/ lar 'o skol rnams slob dpon klu sgrub kyis bshes spring du gsungs pa ltar/ 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad po 'di spong bar ma nus pa kho nas lan pa ste/ 448)brgyad gang zhe na zang zing sogs rnyed na dga' ba dang*/ ma rnyed na mi dga' ba dang*/ rang gi yon tan gzhan la grags na dga' zhing ma grags na mi dga' ba dang*/ gzhan gyis rang la bstod na dga' la/ smad na mi dga' ba dang*/ tshe kho na skyid na dga' zhing*/ sdug na mi dga' ba ste/ de ltar brgyad po 'di blos ma thongs pas phyi ma'i don 'grub par dka' ba'i tshul 'di dpyod ldan rnams kyi dgongs 'tshal lo// de nas sngags klog skabs kyi 'phros pa gnang ba'i char/ snar thang pa'i sngags klog tu gha dzha dha bha rnams las gzhan pa thams cad 'phral yang k+sha ts+tsha/ 'di gnyis 'phral ba'i srol mi 'dug gsungs pa la/ spyir rgya gar nyid du yang skad rigs mi gcig pa mang ba dang*/ sngags klog gi skabs rnams ni saṃ skrita'i skad yin pas phal cher mthun par bshad kyang*/ dper na dz+nyā na zhes pa 'di la yul dbus kyi paṇ+ḍi ta

449)rnams 'gya na zer ba la/ kha che'i paṇ+ḍi rnams gnya' na zer ba bzhin mi gcig pa du ma dang*/ de la brten nas bod kyi lo tsā ba rnams kyang mi mthun pa ches mang ste/ mtha' gcig tu bzung rgyu mi snang yang*/ gha dzha sogs lnga po ni bod yig la thon mi sam+bho sa yig gzugs zur du ma mdzad pas nyis rtsegs 'di lta bu 'di bzhin byung ba ma gtogs ngo bo yig 'bru re re yin te dper na lañcha la ni/ (Sanskrit letter here) 'di lta bu yin tshe 'phral rgyu med la/ de bzhin du k+ṣa yang yi ge gcig tu rtsi ba yin te/ gnyis su byas na dbyangs gsal gyi grangs yang mi 'grig par 'gyur ro/ yang gong du nyid kyis smos pa'i yig 'bru de gnyis ni gsal byed nyis brtsegs/ (Sanskrit letter) yin pas/ steng ma de yi ge snga ma la sbyar dgos te srog med yin pa'i phyir ro/ dper na/ yak+sha rak+sha/ 'di lta bu byung na/ yag sha 450)rag sha lta bur brjod do/ yang*/ pra yats+tsha/ pra tits+tsha/ lta bu la/ pra yad tsha/ pra tīd tsha/ zhes pa ltar 'don no/ k+ṣa ni yi ge gcig yin kyang*/ pak+ṣa/ rak+ṣa/ pak+ṣa lta bu byung dus/ ka des gong ma la cung zad sbyar nas 'don te/ yag khya/ rag khya/ pag khya zhes pa lta bu bya'o/ gzhan yang ya btags can gyi rigs/ h+ya/ bh+ya/ shu n+ya tā sogs dang*/ wa btags can/ sa twa/ shwa ra/ dz+wa la/ zhes pa sogs rnams kyi bklog lugs mi 'dra ba yod de/ rgya gar tī na ra ka'i paṇ+ḍi ta shrī ma ṇi ka'i gsung rgyun gyi rjes 'brangs snar thang lo tsā'i bzhed pa ni/ ya btags can rnams 'greng bu la ya sgra cung zad dang bcas pa dgos par bzhed de/ he ya/ bhe ya/ shu ne ya tā zhes pa lta bu dang*/ wa zur can la yang na ro wa sgra dang ldan pa ste/ sa to wa/ sho wa ra/ dzo wa la/ lta bur bzhed do/ gsal byed la dbyangs ri 451)la zhugs pa rnams kyang dper na/ kṛ/ kl̥/ a mṛ ta sogs la/ ki ri/ ki li/ a mi ri ta sogs brjod la/ dbyangs i bzhugs pas gi gu ma log pa la ni/

kri/ kli/ lta bu la/ ka ri/ ka li/ zhes sogs brjod par bzhed do/ yang*/ paṇa chen nags rin gyi rjes 'brang*/ 'gos lo gzhon nu dpal dang*/ zha lu lo chen sogs kyi bzhed pa ni/ h+ya/ bh+ya/ shu n+ya tā sogs la/ he/ bhe/ shu ne tā/ zhes par brjod pa dang*/ sa twa/ shwa ra/ dz+wa la sogs kyang*/ sa to/ sho ra/ dzo la zhes pa ltar brjod cing*/ 'on kyang*/ rgya skad la 'greng bu dang na ro dngos bstan yod pa thams cad gnyis yun can gyi ring po yin te/ sgra mdo las/ mtshams sbyor gyi sgra rnams rtag tu ring por gnas so/ zhes bshad pa ltar yin mod kyang*/ ya btags can dang*/ wa zur can gyi rigs 'di rnams ni 'greng bu dang na ro thung ngur bklag dgos pa'o/ gzhan 452)yang zhwa lu lo tsā sogs kyi lugs 'di la ni dbyangs ri li bzhugs pa'i gi gu phyir log can la/ kṛ/ kl̥/ bklag chul ni/ kir ri/ kil li/ zhes pa lta bu dang*/ a mrir ri ta ces pa ltar klog dgos par gsungs so/ gzhan yang rta mgrin gyi sngags h+ya gṝ ba zhes ha la ya btags 'bri ba mang por snang yang*/ 'di la ya btags mi 'bri ste/ ha ya zhes so sor 'bri dgos par bshad/ bh+yoḥzhes pa 'di la/ bh+yo bi shwa mu khe zhes sogs sngags spyi khyab thams cad la 'phral nas bklag ste/ bha yo zhes bya ba yang dmigs bsal du ma mo dang lha mo sogs kyi srog snying dang*/ drag las bzlog bsgyur sogs kyi skabs su ni 'phral mi rung ste/ 'byo zhes brjod dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ skabs 'di ni legs sbyar gyi sngags ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ 'dis mtshon te skabs thob kyi bye brag shes dgos par gda' yang*/ sngags thams cad saṃ skṛ ta'i skad gcig bur 'dod mkhan mang ste/ 453)de'i phyir gsar ma ba rnams/ rnying lugs kyi badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal zhes sogs la/ sngags rgya min bod min du 'don zhes bka' bkyon mdzad mod kyang*/ so so la dgos pa skabs don re 'byung tshe/

rang lugs dang ma mthun pa kho na la bka' bkyon mdzad pas mi 'thus te/ dper na/ oṃ yig gcig pu la'ang skabs don mi 'dra ba yod de/ spyi khyab tu ni/ rdo rje rtse mo'i rgyud las/ oṃ ni ci zhig yin par bshad// mchog dang nor gter dpal dang g.yang*// bskal bzang rnam pa dang ldan zhing*// dam bca' ba dang bkra shis don// nor bu 'dzin pa'i snying po yin/ zhes pa la brten na/ legs sbyar sor bzhag pa'i dbang du mdzad de gsar ma'i sngags 454)klog thams cad las/ rnying ma rnams oṃ la 'a btags pa ni shin tu 'khrul te/ na ro yod bzhin 'a 'dogs kyi dgos pa med cing*/ legs sbyar skad dang rgya yig la 'a med pa'i phyir ro/ zhes sogs mgrin gcig tu gsung mod kyang*/ oṃ thams cad legs sbyar lugs kyi gcig bu ma yin te/ mtshon byed dpe'i yi ge dang*/ mtshon bya don gyi yi ge gnyis las/ rnying lugs kyi ā+oṃ 'a 'dogs yod sa'i rigs 'di ni don gyi yi ge nyid yin te/ don gang yin/ sku lnga dang ye shes lnga'i don mtshon pa yin tshul/ rgyud las/ a ni rnam snang 'a mi skyod// na ro rin chen 'byung ldan de// zla tshes snang ba mtha' yas la// thig le don yod grub pa'o/ zhes dang*/ a chos dbyings ye shes/ 'a me long ye shes/ na ro mnyam nyid ye shes/ zla tshes sor rtog ye shes/ thig le bya grub ye shes su gsungs pa sogs kyi don la sbyor ba ma gtogs/ na ro yod bzhin du ring cha la 455)bsam nas 'a 'dogs mdzad pa ma yin tshe/ pad+ma 'byung gnas dang bi ma la sogs kyi saṃskṛ ta'i skad mi mkhyen pa ga la 'ongs kyang*/ don la dgongs pa'i skabs thob yin na'ang*/ 'di ltar ma go bar/ rnying ma bar 'dod pa'i blun po bdag gis ni oṃ yod tshad la 'a dgos par 'dod la/ gsar ma'i sgra pa rnams kyis ni oṃ thams cad la 'a mi 'dod pa sogs/ phyogs re'i kha 'dzin gyis go mi chod par gda' ba dang*/

gzhan yang snar thang pa'i sngags klog 'grel par/ sngags dag par dgos tshul brjod pa'i skabs su/ bod mos pas 'grub pa sogs la bka' bkyon mdzad snang yang*/ jo bo rje mgul bsnyun pa'i rim gror sang ston la rnam rgyal gyi gzungs 'don du bcug pas/ ma dag tshabs che ba gsan tshe bzhad mo shor bas brnag rdol zhing bsnyun dwangs bas/ jo bo'i bka' las 456)khyod bod 'di mos pa kho nas 'grub par snang bas/ khyod rang tsho'i lugs ltar 'thon gsungs 'dug tshe/ mos pa dang ting 'dzin kho na gal che bar yod snang bas des na sgra tshig kho na la zhen mi 'tshal bar yang mkhyen par mdzad du gsol/ zhes 'phros don zhus pa'o/ yang nyid kyis/ dag yig gi skabs rnams dza yig la ra mgo dang sa mgo gzab shur gnyis la tha dad du 'ong mi thang ba la/ so sor byung ba 'di gang yin gsungs ba/ 'di skabs gzhan ma yang de ltar gsung mkhan byung zhing*/ bdag kyang dang por the tshom byung bas mkhas pa 'ga' la dogs gcod kyang zhus pa yin pas/ rdza/ 'di pa mgo lar nas ma yin te/ za ma tog nas/ ra mgo ldan pa bcu gnyis gsungs pa'i sde mtshan yin pa dang*/ de bzhin du la mgo ldan pa bcu/ sa mgo ldan pa bcu gcig du gsungs pa 'di ni dag yig chen mo thams cad 457)mthun la/ rdza 'di bshur ma'i gzugs 'di ltar byung ba ni yi ge lus 'gyur yin te/ dper na sa la pa btags pa'i gzugs kyang*/ spa/ 'di lta bur byung ba dang*/ gzhan yang lus gyur gyi rigs ma te/ ra btags zhabs kyu dgos pa thams cad zhabs kyu nyis rtsegs/ khru gru dru sogs 'byung ba lta bu dang*/ ga'i rgyab tu sa mtha' dgos mkhan rnams la log 'bri ba dang*/ na log ṇa la med zer dgos pa dang*/ bhai la sgom zer dgos pa sogs kyi lus 'gyur mang du 'byung mod la/ rgya gar gyi yi ge la ni dbyangs yig re re la'ang gzugs mi gcig pa ni a'i lus 'gyur yin no/ des na rdza 'di sbyor klog sogs kyi tshe yang ra mgor bslab cing 'bri ba'i tshe yang bshur ma la/

sa'i 'og tu ja btags 'dra ba 'di 'bri bar bya zhing*/ gzab ma la ni ra mgo nyid du 'byung bas go sla'o// yang*/ phran bu'i don bskor gyi phebs sgo'i/ srid pa gsum 458)ni/ steng lha'i srid pa/ 'og klu'i srid pa/ bar mi'i srid pa dang gsum/ 'jig rten gsum yang de rnams te/ lha'i 'jig rten zhes sogs so/ khams gsum ni/ gzugs kyi khams/ gzugs med kyi khams/ 'dod pa'i khams so/ sa gsum ni/ sa 'og sa steng*/ sa bla dang gsum ste/ sa bla zhes pa ni sa'i gong la 'jug tshe/ bar snang sogs yin no/ 'ga' zhig tu grong khyer gsum zhes pa'ang 'byung ba ni/ snang ba'i grong khyer/ phyed snang ba'i grong khyer/ mi snang ba'i grong khyer/ zhes pa gsum ni/ 'dod khams/ gzugs khams/ gzugs med khams rnams dang gcig pa nyid lags so// de ltar brjod bya'i chos tshul ji snyed la// dri med gzigs pa'i spyan yangs mi pham mgon// gang khyed mi shes mun khrod mi gnas kyang*// gzhan la phan dgongs 'ba' shig 'dir brtson mdzad/ bstan pa'i mtha' 'dir bshes gnyen rab dkon zhing*// yod rnams 459)chos brgyad rta bang 'gran la brel// de phyir legs bshad 'tshol dang sbyin pa po// gnyis kas dben 'dir bdag 'dra'i tshig gis ci// mkhas rnams mgu ba'i tshig gi rnam dpyod med// grub pa dgyes pa'i nyams myong don gyis stongs// cal col yi ger 'god pa'i spyi brtol 'di// mi rgan spobs pa che ba'i sug rjes lags// shes nas smras na mkhas pa'i lugs yin kyang*// mi shes smra mang dpyod ldan 'khrel ba'i rgyu// don med glegs bam longs 'dra'i dri lan 'dir// 'gal 'khrul bzod par bzhes gcig mi pham mgon// gal te tshul 'dir legs bshad cha mchis na// de yis dge mthu ji snyed yod pa dang*// rnam dkar bsam pa'i mthu byin yongs bsdoms te// srid zhi'i 'dam las 'gro kun 'dren par shog
ces pa 'di yang snyigs mthar skyes pa'i rnying hrul gyi btsun pa mkhas mchog pad+ma legs grub rtsal gyis kong rong zad mtha'i ri khrod nas phul ba maṅga laṃ// dge'o// 460)
